jobs.title: Operatør til Stena
jobs.description:
Trives du med rutineprægede opgaver, hvor kvalitet og sund fornuft er i højsædet? Vil du være med på en vækstrejse, hvor teamet går fra 5 til over 20 ansatte, og hvor dit arbejde gør en direkte forskel for miljøet? Så er det nu, du skal slå til!

Om Stena Recycling

Stena Recycling er førende inden for bæredygtige affaldsløsninger. De lever af at give ressourcer nyt liv, og på deres lokation i Roskilde har de stort fokus på batterisortering. De er en arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerheden altid kommer først, og hvor man vægter et godt fællesskab højt. De står over for en spændende udvidelse – særligt i forhold til håndtering af elbilsbatterier – og mangler de rette hænder til at hjælpe dem med at bygge fundamentet for fremtiden.

Særligt for lokationen i Roskilde er, at der udelukkende håndteres to typer affald: Batterier og på sigt elbilsbatterier- en vigtig opgave inden for det grønne område, der kun bliver større med tiden

Om jobbet

Som operatør hos Stena Recycling bliver du en central del af deres sorteringsflow, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre korrekt håndtering og sortering af batterier direkte ved produktionsbåndet. Arbejdet kræver både koncentration og fysisk indsats, da batterierne sorteres manuelt for at sikre, at de værdifulde nikkelmetaller kan udvindes og genbruges.

Sideløbende med sorteringsarbejdet vil du stå for den interne logistik, hvor du betjener mindre gaffeltrucks, stablere og klemmetrucks til at afhente, transportere og placere materialerne de rette steder på pladsen.

Da afdelingen er i vækst, vil hverdagen også byde på diverse ad hoc-opgaver og forfaldent arbejde.

  • Arbejdstider: Vi kører pt. skiftehold med dertilhørende tillæg. Dog er det også muligt at arbejde rent daghold eller rent aftenhold, men ideelt set vil vi gerne have et skiftehold op og stå.

Din profil:

Vi leder efter dig, der møder ind med en positiv indstilling og en god portion sund fornuft. Da vi arbejder med materialer, der skal behandles på en speciel måde, er det vigtigt, at du er kvalitetsbevidst.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Du kan have en baggrund som procesoperatør, produktion, lager eller lignende.

Du taler og forstår dansk.

Du har almindeligt kørekort B.

Du har truckcertifikat

Har du kurset "Varmt arbejde!" er det en fordel

Som person trives du i et arbejdsmiljø med faste rutiner, hvor du sætter en ære i at levere en ensartet høj kvalitet i din sortering. Da sikkerhed er højeste prioritet, forventer vi, at du møder ind med sund fornuft og en ansvarsbevidst indstilling til dit arbejde og dine kolleger.

Vi tilbyder:

Hos Stena Recycling bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor din sikkerhed, tryghed og trivsel altid kommer i første række. Vi tilbyder et job med gode rotationsmuligheder og hjælpsomme kolleger i et stærkt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet og hjælpsomhed er i højsædet. Du får rig mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle dig personligt i takt med, at deres afdeling vokser.

Stillingen starter som et Try & Hire-forløb med gode muligheder for efterfølgende fastansættelse for den rette kandidat. Som ansat får du naturligvis stillet arbejdstøj til rådighed og en frokostordning.

Ansøgning og kontakt:

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på "ansøg". Randstad varetager rekrutteringsprocessen på vegne af Stena Recycling. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt, og der afholdes løbende interviews. Så send gerne din ansøgning så hurtigt som muligt, hvis du vil med på holdet.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Liv Nielsen på liv.nielsen@randstad.dk.

Om Randstad:

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle, uanset baggrund, og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

jobs.title: Ingénieur procédés analytiques H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
English version below

À la suite d'une mobilité interne, nous recherchons un Ingénieur procédés analytiques (h/f) pour notre laboratoire.

Rejoindre l'équipe du laboratoire pour jouer un rôle central dans l'excellence analytique de notre activité Électronique, un secteur en forte expansion. Vos responsabilités clés vous placeront au cœur de l'innovation et de l'expertise.

Description du poste :

- Piloter l'innovation analytique : Mener les développements analytiques stratégiques et la qualification de nouvelles molécules pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits.

- Expertise de pointe : Diriger les développements en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique, spécifiquement pour les molécules organosilicitées et organométalliques.

- Partage de connaissances : Former nos équipes aux techniques analytiques les plus avancées et apporter une expertise spécialisée en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique.

- Assurance qualité : Gérer la qualification des nouveaux fournisseurs de molécules et définir les protocoles de qualification en étroite collaboration avec le service Qualité.

- Interface internationale : Servir de point de contact analytique et technique auprès des laboratoires internationaux d'Air Liquide (notamment Fremont et Dallas) pour des études de corrélation stratégiques.

- Leadership et amélioration continue : Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue en faisant preuve d'une force de proposition affirmée, notamment en matière de sécurité, et en assurant un management transversal efficace.

english version :
- Following an internal mobility within the company, we are seeking a Process Engineer Analytics (m/f) for our laboratory.
- Join the laboratory team to play a central role in the analytical excellence of our Electronics business, a rapidly expanding sector. Your key responsibilities will allow you to be at the forefront of innovation and expertise.
- Drive Analytical Innovation: Lead strategic analytical developments and the qualification of new molecules, thereby ensuring the reliability of our products.
- Cutting-Edge Expertise: Lead developments in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography, specifically for organosilicate and organometallic molecules.
- Knowledge Sharing: Train our teams on the most advanced analytical techniques and provide specialized expertise in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography.
- Quality Assurance: Manage the qualification of new molecule suppliers and define qualification protocols in close collaboration with the Quality department.
- International Interface: Act as the analytical and technical point of contact with Air Liquide's international laboratories (notably Fremont and Dallas) for crucial correlation studies.
- Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Actively contribute to continuous improvement, demonstrating a strong proposal-making capacity, particularly regarding safety, and ensuring effective cross-functional management.

jobs.title: Ønsker du en meningsfull og variert deltidsjobb? Bli min personlige assistent!
jobs.description:
Jeg er en godt voksen dame med mye livsglede og har ønske om en mer aktiv hverdag. For å ha overskudd til det som betyr mest for meg, trenger jeg praktisk bistand på grunn av en fysisk funksjonsvariasjon. Nå ser jeg etter deg som kan være min stødige arm, som deltidsansatt eller tilkallingsvikar. Vurderer å ansette 1-2 faste ansatte og 1-2 tilkallingsvikarer som brukerstyrt personlig assistenter.

Dagene mine er varierte, og arbeidsoppgavene vil speile dette. Jeg trenger hjelp til og fra fysioterapi to ganger i uken, praktiske oppgaver, noe matlaging og baking. Jeg er også glad i sosiale aktiviteter, så du vil være et viktig følge på kafé, shopping, kino, konserter – og potensielt kortere reiser. Jobben innebærer også bistand med noe personlig hygiene, og derfor oppfordres spesielt voksne kvinner til å søke.

Dette ser jeg etter i deg: Du er stabil og ansvarsfull. Erfaring er ikke påkrevd eller nødvendig. Personlig kjemi og gjensidig fleksibilitet er viktig. Det er også en stor fordel om du har gode datakunnskaper.

Arbeidstid: Stillingen innebærer hovedsaklig vakter på dagtid (3-6 timers varighet, ca. 1-2 ganger i uken), med mulighet for noe kveldsjobbing knyttet til sosiale aktiviteter. Jeg er fleksibel og vi legger en plan som fungerer for oss begge!

Hva kreves av deg?
Det settes krav om minimum 23 år, grunnet forsikringer. Videre kreves ingen kompetanse/utdanning eller erfaring fra tidligere. All nødvendig opplæring vil bli gitt, herunder opplæring i hverdagen med arbeidsleder og digitale assistentkurs fra Humana Omsorg og Assistanse.


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS og MOVA

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in immunology
jobs.description:
About the position

A 3-year fixed-term postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) within the field of immunology is available at the Department of Diakonhjemmet Research and Teaching, Division of Orthopaedic Surgery, Institute of Clinical Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, University of Oslo. The position will be available from November 2026.

This position is part of a new translational research center (KG Jebsen Center for Specific Autoimmune Therapy) aiming to develop antigen-specific B-cell depletion strategies for treatment of autoimmune diseases. Professor Ludvig M. Sollid leads the center. The postdoctor will be supervised by Dr Guro Løvik Goll, senior researcher and consultant at Dept Rheumatology/REMEDY research center, Diakonhjemmet Hospital together with Professor Sollid and Professor Øyvind Molberg, Dept Rheumatology, Oslo University Hospital (OUH). The work will be carried out in close collaboration with other researchers and clinicians at Diakonhjemmet Hospital.

The work of this research project will be carried out in close partnership with a diverse team that spans multiple disciplines, from both basic and clinical research environments, emphasizing the need for strong communication and interpersonal abilities. The successful applicant will primarily do lab work at the Sollid lab at OUH, but will also be strongly embedded in the REMEDY research center at Diakonhjemmet Hospital. The post doc will be expected to take part in discussions, meetings and project presentations both at Dept Immunology OUH and at REMEDY-senter, Diakonhjemmet Hospital 


Project description

The K.G. Jebsen Center for Specific Autoimmune Therapy centers on the investigation of novel B-cell depleting therapies in autoimmune diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis (RA). The successful applicant for this post doc position will monitor PAD2/PAD4-specific and ACPA-specific B cells in patients treated with B-cell depleting agents. The aim of the project is to develop tools that allow monitoring of disease-relevant B-cell populations through B-cell depletion therapy and to assess correlations between presence of antigen-specific B cells and defined disease states.

The duration of appointment is 3 years.


Duties of the position

The postdoctor is expected to take active part in the research cooperation within the group, and will be supported in acquiring qualifications, promoting current and future work in higher academic positions within the relevant disciplines.

The objective of the project is research activity associated with the defined objectives of the center, the major work assignments being:

  • Help organize the clinical part of the project, help recruit and obtain biological samples from relevant patients
  • Isolation of immune cells from patient samples
  • Identification and characterisation of antigen-specific cells by flow cytometry and cell-culture assays
  • Cloning and recombinant expression of rearranged B-cell receptor genes from antigen-specific B cells and plasma cells 
  • Writing of scientific papers and presentation of results at international conferences

In addition, the researcher will be encouraged to present their research regularly both at the Department of Immunology OUH, at REMEDY research center, Diakonhjemmet Hospital and at international scientific conferences.


Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • To be appointed as a postdoctoral fellow, a doctoral degree is required in medicine, molecular biology, basic immunology or a related area
  • Background in basic immunological research 
  • Experience with relevant techniques: flow cytometry, cell culture, ELISA, molecular biology including PCR, cloning of genes and generation of transfectans. 
  • Demonstrated experience in project management, scientific writing and scientific presentations
  • Fluent in spoken and written English
     

Desired qualifications

  • Previous experience with clinical studies and patients is an advantage, but not a requirement

Personal qualities

We are looking for a highly motivated, hard-working and organized candidate. A successful candidate should have a genuine interest in pursuing an academic career and possess the following strengths:

  • Strong scientific capacity and analytical skills as well as the ability to handle large, shared projects in multidisciplinary teams
  • Capability to work both independently and as a team player
  • Willingness to learn new skills as the laboratory grows and techniques evolve
  • An interest in working with clinicians as well as researchers in basic immunology
  • Interest in conveying their own research as well as other relevant scientific knowledge to clinicians
  • Personal suitability for the position, as well as genuine motivation for the project

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a great working environment and the opportunity to do research that bridge basic science with clinical studies. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 679 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications
  • Project description
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • Contact information for 2-3 references

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

A strong focus on customer service, quality and presentation. The ability to manage a busy operation while keeping on top of compliance and budgets. Why Sodexo? jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Salon alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Plant Engineering · Stockholm

Blykalla is scaling quickly to industrialize our small modular reactor (SMR) concept. If you are passionate about nuclear technology and want to make a meaningful impact, join us.

What we do at Blykalla

Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company developing lead-cooled small modular reactors. Our compact reactor design combines high safety with a simple, cost-effective and scalable approach to delivering clean, reliable baseload energy that complements solar and wind power.

The role

As Reliability Engineer, you will own reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) engineering for Blykalla’s SEALER-55 lead-cooled fast reactor (LFR). You will work across assigned plant areas, systems and work packages within Plant Engineering, delivering quantitative reliability analysis that supports the plant design and the probabilistic safety assessment (PSA).

You will establish and apply Blykalla’s RAM, FMEA and FMECA framework, ensuring reliability and availability targets are translated into design, redundancy, sparing, testing and maintenance requirements. You will assess how design and maintenance decisions affect plant availability and lifecycle performance, and support the project from design through procurement, construction and handover to commissioning and operations.

What you’ll do

RAM engineering and modelling

    Establish and maintain RAM, FMEA and FMECA methods, templates, criticality criteria, data sources and analysis assumptions.
    Define reliability design bases, RAM targets, modelling methodology and requirements for assigned areas.
    Build and maintain reliability block diagrams, fault trees and availability models, including Markov or Monte-Carlo simulations.
    Work in RiskSpectrum for fault-tree and PSA-aligned modelling, alongside relevant RAM tools such as ReliaSoft, Isograph, GRIF or Maros/Taro.
    Flow reliability, availability and maintainability requirements into specifications, data sheets and supplier packages.

Analysis and technical input

    Perform and review RAM studies, FMEA/FMECA, reliability-centred maintenance analyses, criticality ranking, spares and logistics modelling, and lost-production analyses.
    Quantify the impact of redundancy, maintenance strategies, test intervals and sparing on availability and lifecycle performance.
    Develop reliability data and failure-rate estimates using sources such as ISO 14224 and OREDA, including Weibull/life-data analysis and common-cause assumptions.
    Provide component failure data, maintenance assumptions and common-cause inputs to the PSA and safety case.

Interfaces, suppliers and delivery

    Coordinate with process, mechanical, rotating equipment, electrical, I&C, civil and structural, layout, safety and licensing, and operations and maintenance teams.
    Identify and resolve issues related to single points of failure, common-cause vulnerabilities, testability, maintainability and maintenance access.
    Set and review RAM requirements for RFQs and supplier packages, including reliability data, FMECA and reliability demonstration requirements.
    Contribute to estimates, schedules, risk reviews, design reviews, RFIs, site queries and change requests, including assessment of availability impacts.

Capability building

    Mentor engineers and improve reliability methods, templates, checklists and data libraries.
    Help build a scalable reliability engineering capability that supports Blykalla’s plant-as-a-product mindset, modular design and DfMA approach.

Typical deliverables

Reliability design bases and RAM targets; reliability block diagrams, fault trees and availability models; RAM study reports; FMEA/FMECA and criticality registers; RCM analyses; reliability data libraries; PSA inputs; supplier review comments; interface registers; and change-control or handover inputs.

Who you are

You have:

    At least 6 years of hands-on experience in reliability or RAM engineering, including nuclear experience and RAM/PSA-support analysis for nuclear plants or systems.
    Experience leading reliability engineering across a major plant area, full project or several complex work packages.
    Strong quantitative RAM modelling skills and practical experience with RiskSpectrum.
    Knowledge of relevant reliability and dependability standards, including IEC 60300, IEC 61078, IEC 61025, IEC 61165, IEC 61649 and IEC 60812.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
What we do at Blykalla

Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company developing next-generation small modular reactors (SMRs) to deliver clean, safe, and reliable energy. Our lead-cooled reactor design enables high safety in a compact format, making it scalable and cost-efficient — and a strong complement to renewable energy.

We are now entering a phase where structured, high-quality engineering execution is critical to moving from design to reality — and this is where you come in.

What you’ll get to do

As Senior Project Engineering Manager (PEM), you lead the engineering execution of Blykalla’s SEALER reactor programme. You sit at the intersection of technical leadership, project delivery, and regulatory compliance — ensuring that multidisciplinary teams move in sync, milestones are met, and engineering output is robust and licensable.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role where you both define how we work and ensure it gets done.

You translate complex technical requirements into clear execution plans, align teams across disciplines, and create the structure needed to deliver a first-of-a-kind nuclear system.

You will also play a key role in shaping how we scale engineering at Blykalla, driving the adoption of design for fabrication and modularization, model-based engineering, PLM systems, and data-driven workflows.

Responsibilities

Engineering execution & technical leadership

    Define and drive a clear engineering execution plan with an aligned schedule, deliverables, cost, and responsibilities
    Lead coordination across disciplines (reactor, mechanical, electrical, I&C, structural, safety) to ensure system integration
    Ensure effective engineering workflows, design control processes, and validation approaches are implemented
    Ensure engineering output meets quality, safety, and regulatory requirements throughout the lifecycle

Risk, safety & licensing

    Identify and manage technical and regulatory risks early, before they impact delivery
    Ensure traceability and documentation needed for licensing and safety case development
    Lead key engineering risk methodologies such as FMEA and probabilistic risk assessment
    Interface with regulatory bodies and certification authorities

Cross-functional collaboration

    Act as the central engineering interface across project management, engineering teams, suppliers, and regulators
    Align stakeholders and maintain momentum through structured coordination
    Support procurement with nuclear-grade technical requirements and supplier evaluation
    Promote a strong safety culture and design-for-safety mindset
    Ensure early designs implement pre-fabrication and modularization principles, and get early contractor engagement as required.

Delivery, planning & improvement

    Contribute to realistic planning of engineering scope, resources, cost,, and timelines
    Track progress and ensure predictable delivery against milestones
    Drive continuous improvement in how we execute and scale engineering
    Ensure smooth handover from engineering to manufacturing, construction, and operations

Who you’ll work with

You will be part of the Plant Engineering Team and work closely with discipline leads, the CTO, project managers, and external partners. You will be a key integrator across technical domains in a team that is highly driven and committed to building something meaningful.

Who you are

Domain expertise

    MSc or equivalent in Mechanical, Nuclear, Systems, Electrical Engineering, or similar
    Strong experience leading engineering delivery in complex, regulated environments (e.g. nuclear, aerospace, oil & gas, defence)
    Proven ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams through complex programme phases
    Solid understanding of relevant regulatory frameworks and standards (SSM, IAEA, ASME, IEC, IEEE)
    Experience with risk methodologies such as FMEA and probabilistic risk assessment
    Familiarity with modern engineering environments (e.g. PLM, model-based engineering)

How you work

    You bring structure and clarity to complex engineering challenges
    You balance technical rigour with practical delivery
    You anticipate risks and act early
    You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and building processes as you go

Cultural contribution

    You lead with clarity and accountability, and bring people with you
    You build trust through transparency and reliability
    You are motivated by solving hard, first-of-a-kind problems
    You care about how teams work together and contribute to a strong, collaborative environment
    Fluent in English; Swedish is a plus

Why join Blykalla

    Work on first-of-a-kind nuclear technology with real global impact
    Take on a high-ownership role at the core of our delivery
    Be part of a fast-growing, ambitious, and highly skilled team
    Help shape how next-generation nuclear engineering is done

Location

Stockholm

Apply

If you want to play a key role in bringing next-generation nuclear technology from concept to reality, we’d love to hear from you.

We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace and believe that diversity of perspectives leads to better teams and better technology.

We do not accept applications via email.

We are not open to external recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Manager Technical Core Team, back-end sales ABB Motion
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to: Sales Support Manager - Customer Support.

At ABB Motion we work closely together with our customers to find new solutions for a better, more energy-efficient future. On this journey, we need to find new creative ways of doing business. By building relationships, inspiring and finding new ways of collaborating you will push the boundaries and reach beyond current levels. Come join us on the journey!

You will lead a team of 11 specialists across three key disciplines, all working together to support the sales of our Electric Motors and Drives. The team provides technical expertise, manages delivery projects, and coordinates our most complex quotations and tenders. The team includes five Bid Engineers, three Delivery Project Managers, and three Product Managers, with responsibility for Low Voltage and High Voltage Motors and Drives respectively. Our sales organization is supporting the Swedish market, and as your team members are based across Sweden in several local offices, you will lead a geographically distributed organization. Therefore, success in this role requires strong remote leadership skills, combined with regular travel to meet and support your team members in person.

To lead this team, you also need to have a broad technical understanding but don’t have to be a specialist yourself. Since the team is cooperating with many stakeholders, customers, internal teams and internal production units; a collaborative mindset is essential to achieve success in this position. Both in terms of motivating and inspiring the team but also by being a collaborative leader amongst your peers, as you will be a part of the Local Management Team. You are also involved in discussions and escalations with the production units regarding deliveries and technical solutions. You communicate daily with the sales team, where you together support the customer in the best way.

Your responsibilities

    Lead, coach and motivate the team to deliver the best possible technical solutions and support to our customers.
    Drive continuous improvements to deliver exceptional customer experience while adapting to the demands of a dynamic and changing environment.
    Further develop the team to strengthen technical expertise and ensure alignment with Motion's long-term strategy.
    Secure and maintain robust processes, systems, and reporting structures to support operational excellence.
    Serve as an active member of the Local Management team

With curiosity you constantly seek new opportunities to expand the business and find new solutions to creating superior customer experience. The preferred location for this role is Västerås. However, for the right candidate, the position can also be based at one of our other ABB offices in Sweden.

Your background

    You have held a leadership position, preferably within a technical sales organization or another technical environment. Experience managing direct reports in a geographically dispersed team is considered an advantage.
    Previous experience in technical sales, delivery projects, or other roles involving advanced technical expertise and technical dialogue with stakeholders is highly desirable.
    You demonstrate strong leadership, collaboration, and a results-driven mindset. You proactively challenge and support stakeholders while ensuring that quotations, bids, and delivery projects progress efficiently and achieve their objectives.
    We believe you hold an engineering degree in a relevant technical field, such as Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a related discipline. Alternatively, you have extensive experience within similar industries.
    Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken, is required, as you will work with international companies operating in the Swedish market.

More about us

ABB Motion High Power (MOHP) Division offers a comprehensive product portfolio of large AC motors and generators. From general purpose to highly customized designs, synchronous motors provide high efficiency, reliability and availability across all major industries and applications, including some in the toughest and most demanding environments. The division also has a long track record of designing and building generators for wide range of industries, including power generation, marine, oil and gas, mining, and data centers.

jobs.title: Helsefagarbeider
jobs.description:
Er du en engasjert helsefagarbeider som ønsker å gjøre en forskjell i menneskers liv?

Hjemmetjenesten Sør har ledig en fast stilling på en 80 % som helsefagarbeider og vi søker etter dedikerte medarbeidere til hjemmetjenesten i vår vakre distriktskommune.

Stillingen har per tiden todelt turnus og jobb hver tredje helg. Hjemmetjenesten sør har kontorer på Halsa, Vall, Meløya og Bolga i Meløy kommune. Den aktuelle stillingen vil ha base på Halsa og Vall.

Hjemmetjenesten yter tjenester til hjemmeboende i alle aldre som har rett på nødvendig helsehjelp i henhold til Helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven. Våre brukere har vedtak på hjemmetjeneste, middagslevering, trygghetsalarm og praktisk bistand. Gjennom hjelp til selvhjelp gis pleie- og omsorgstrengende mulighet til å bo i eget hjem så lenge som mulig. Hjemmetjenesten er bemannet 24 timer i døgnet hele året.

Som helsefagarbeider i hjemmetjenesten vil du oppleve meningsfulle menneskemøter hver dag. Du får muligheten til å bidra til at våre brukere kan leve et trygt og godt liv hjemme. Arbeidsoppgavene er varierte og givende, og du vil være en viktig del av et inkluderende kollegium med en sterk delingskultur.
Våre brukere bor spredt i kommunen, det betyr en del kjøring i løpet av arbeidsdagen.

Oppstart etter avtale. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Daglig stell, pleie og yte gode omsorgstjenester for pasientene
  • Dele ut medisiner
  • Dialog med pårørende
  • Ivareta pasientsikkerhet
  • Målrettet miljøarbeid
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Personsentrert omsorg
  • Bidra til aktivitet og god livskvalitet for pasientene
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev og autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider. Dersom ingen av søkerne oppfyller kravet om fagbrev som helsefagarbeider, vil elever under utdanning/ i siste års læretid som helsefagarbeider, vil også kunne vurderes for ansettelse.
  • Andre relevante helseutdanninger som ambulansearbeidere og helsesekretærer kan vurderes.
  • Gode norskkunnskaper både muntlig og skriftlig. Utenlandske søkere må kunne dokumentere norskopplæring på nivå B2.
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er selvstendig, fleksibel og ansvarsfull
  • Du tar initiativ, er positiv og løsningsorientert
  • Du har evne og vilje til å jobbe målrettet og strukturert
  • Interessert i nytenkning og villig til å være med å utvikle fremtidens helsetjeneste
Vi tilbyr

jobs.title: Head of Commercial Delivery
jobs.description:
Altris is looking for a Head of Commercial Delivery to take responsibility for the execution and delivery of strategic customer and partner engagements.

In this role, you will ensure that commercial commitments and signed agreements are translated into clear, prioritised and executable delivery plans. You will work cross-functionally across the organisation and act as a key link between business development, customers, partners and internal delivery teams.

Key responsibilities

    Own contract-to-delivery execution for strategic customer and partner engagements.
    Translate contractual deliverables into executable plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
    Manage the formal handover from Business Development to delivery as engagements progress into contracting and execution.
    Coordinate and prioritise activities and resources across multiple customer and partner projects.
    Establish and run delivery governance, identify bottlenecks and drive actions to keep projects on track.
    Maintain an up-to-date overview of delivery status and delivery health across key engagements.
    Provide management with clear, fact-based reporting on progress, risks, deviations and required actions.
    Develop and implement transparent methods for prioritising activities across commercial engagements.

About you

We are looking for someone with experience in project management, commercial delivery, operations or a similar role within an industrial or technology-driven environment. You are comfortable managing complex, cross-functional projects involving both internal and external stakeholders.

You have a structured and analytical approach, strong communication skills and the ability to translate commercial commitments into concrete execution plans. You are comfortable taking ownership, identifying risks and dependencies, and driving projects forward in a fast-moving organisation.

About Altris

Altris is a Swedish battery technology company developing sodium-ion battery materials and technology. The role offers the opportunity to work closely with strategic customers and partners and play a central role in bringing commercial engagements from agreement to successful delivery.

jobs.title: Functional Safety Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Functional Safety Engineer within Automotive. You will work in a team and define concepts and set requirements for the client's platform of electrical vehicles. This is an exciting opportunity to work cross-functionally with innovation defining the future and contribute to the success of our company in the transition to zero emission vehicles.

Job description:

As a Functional Safety Engineer, you will be leading the functional safety activities starting from early concept development, moving on to defining requirements, and ensuring successful verification of the Electromobility system.

• Lead the completion of the functional safety activities including Safety Plan, HARA, TARA,  FSC, TSC, refinement of safety requirements and allocation on components.

• Lead development of and verification of the Functional Safety work products

• Manage ISO 26262 knowledge and safety culture in the team and coach other system engineers in the team.

• Represent the team in functional safety forums.

• Support the performance of the verification review (VR), confirmation review (CR) and functional safety assessment.

• Continuously monitoring/tracking & documenting the system changes for FuSa related products and execute impact analysis.

Experience & skills required:

• You have M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Physics or Computer Science, Mechatronic or similar.

• Minimum 5 years of documented experience within system development and functional safety deliveries according to ISO 26262, preferably within the automotive industry.

• Good knowledge of deployment the functional safety standards in entire product lifecycle from start to start of production (SOP), such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, ISO 13849 etc.

-Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and best practices of automotive standards and regulations (ISO 21434, UN R155) is a plus

• Hands on experience of safety activities, such as Hazard Analysis, technical safety concept, functional safety concept

• Experience of automotive E/E system development. (Including system engineering and/or HW/SW development)

• Experience from working in requirements management tools.

• Fluent in both written and verbal English.

• A driven team player with extensive experience from functional safety engineering along with experience in a dynamic and high paced product development environment.

• You should possess an analytical mindset, adept problem-solving skills, and a keen interest in acquiring new technical knowledge.

• Effective communication skills and strong networking abilities are essential for achieving success in this role.

A plus if you have:

• Background in charging system or electrical power take-off in the automotive industry.

• Previous involvement in functional safety engineering, system engineering or product development in the automotive industry

• Experience in system verification processes.

• Experience in System Weaver, requirement management tools.

•  Fluent in English

Personal Skills required:

• Proactive and self motivated

•  Excellent communication & presentation skills

•  Flexible and analytical

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Dometic is a global leader in outdoor living solutions, providing essential gear for an adventurous lifestyle. We are on an exciting growth and transformation journey – now looking for an exceptional Chief Financial Officer to join our Executive Management Team and help shape the future of Dometic.

This is a unique opportunity for an experienced finance leader to play a pivotal role in shaping Dometic's future. As a key strategic partner to the CEO and Board of Directors, you will drive the continued transformation of our global business, strengthen financial performance, and lead the evolution of our finance organization in a dynamic and complex international environment.

About the position

As CFO of Dometic, you will be responsible for leading the company's global finance organization and driving the financial strategy across the Group. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will oversee Group Business Controlling, Treasury, Tax, Accounting, Internal Audit, Investor Relations, and IT, while working closely with segment leadership teams around the world.

The role combines strategic leadership with operational excellence and requires a strong business mindset, outstanding leadership capability, and the ability to drive transformation across a global organization.

Your main responsibilities

    Act as a strategic partner to the CEO, Executive Management Team, Board of Directors, and investors.
    Lead Dometic's global finance organization and financial transformation.
    Drive financial strategy, performance management, planning, and reporting.
    Lead M&A activities and post-acquisition integration.
    Oversee Investor Relations, Treasury, Tax, Accounting, Internal Audit, and IT.
    Drive capital allocation, financing strategy, and financial governance.
    Develop high-performing teams and support the company's digital transformation.

What do we offer?

You are offered an interesting role in a dynamic, fast paced and global environment with great opportunities to grow, evolve with the company and take on new challenges.

A suitable background would be a solid experience within finance leadership and business transformation as well as the following qualifications and experiences:

    Proven CFO experience in a publicly listed company.
    Strong leadership track record in complex, international organizations.
    Expertise in financial performance management, transformation, and governance.
    Solid experience in M&A, integrations, and corporate finance.
    Strong understanding of capital markets, investor relations, and treasury.
    Experience leading large global teams and driving organizational change.

To be successful in this role, we believe that you possess the following skills, competencies & characteristics:

    A strategic mindset combined with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.

    Strong analytical, commercial, and problem-solving skills.

Dometic's Core Values

To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things.

Intrested?

As part of the recruitment process, personality and logical ability assessments, as well as a background check, will be conducted for the final candidate.

jobs.title: Student Assistant– Cyber Security & Compliance
jobs.description:
Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/ 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant – Cyber Security & Compliance who likes to make a difference!

Job description:

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support the Infrastructure & Security team. The role will work closely with the Cyber Security and Compliance functions, helping maintain governance processes, security operations, reporting, and documentation while gaining practical experience within enterprise IT security and compliance. The position supports activities within vulnerability management, access governance, audits, and security reporting.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations Support

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Assist with endpoint compliance reviews and Intune-related administrative activities.

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Coordinate follow-up with system owners and suppliers regarding security findings.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence.

  • Support preparation for internal and external audits.

  • Maintain compliance documentation and evidence repositories.

  • Track audit findings and remediation activities.

Access Management & Governance

  • Assist with periodic access reviews.

  • Track completion of access review activities.

  • Help maintain governance processes and security controls documentation.

Documentation & Process Management

  • Update security procedures, standards, and runbooks.

  • Maintain SharePoint-based documentation repositories.

  • Ensure documents are reviewed and updated according to governance requirements.

Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within IT, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Excel, and SharePoint is an advantage.

  • Interest in cyber security, governance, risk, and compliance.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note:

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 30/09/2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

If you have any questions, please contact Patrick Frømming, Manager, Infrastructure & Security (PFN@nordic-rcc.net).

jobs.title: Contract Manager

We are on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. Our green steel production in Boden will be powered by one of the world’s largest green hydrogen plants, running on renewable electricity. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. The facility will impact, and shape, the surroundings as well as the perception of Boden, with the aim that it will be seen as a symbol for the much-needed green transition of heavy industry.

jobs.title: Senior HIL Development Engineer – Automotive Embedded Systems
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced HIL Development Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) architecture, development, modelling, integration, and system-level debugging.

This role is focused on developing and maintaining advanced HIL environments used for vehicle system validation. We are looking for engineers who have experience building and improving HIL test systems – not only executing tests. The ideal candidate has a strong background in real-time simulation, ECU integration, automotive communication, and troubleshooting complex embedded systems.

You will work closely with development, verification, and integration teams to secure robust test environments and support the validation of future vehicle technologies.

Key Responsibilities

HIL Development & Integration (Mandatory)

    Design, develop, commission, and maintain HIL test rigs and environments.
    Integrate ECUs, I/O systems, communication interfaces, sensors, and actuators into HIL platforms.
    Configure and set up HIL systems using platforms such as:
    dSPACE
    Vector
    ETAS
    National Instruments (NI)
    Speedgoat
    Develop real-time test environments for vehicle subsystems and complete vehicle validation.
    Define and optimize HIL architecture, signal flow, and interface management.
    Support continuous improvement of HIL setups and validation processes.

HIL Modelling & Real-Time Simulation

    Develop MATLAB/Simulink models for:
    Vehicle systems
    Plant models
    Environment simulation
    Control systems
    Optimize models for real-time execution and HIL deployment.
    Perform model validation, calibration, and debugging in real-time environments.
    Work with simulation tools such as:
    ASM
    CarMaker
    VTD
    PreScan
    Similar simulation platforms

Experience within vehicle dynamics modelling is highly beneficial, including understanding of:

    Longitudinal dynamics
    Lateral dynamics
    Powertrain behavior

Automotive Communication & Diagnostics

    Develop, configure, and troubleshoot automotive communication networks.
    Work hands-on with:
    CAN
    CAN FD
    LIN
    FlexRay
    Automotive Ethernet
    Configure and debug communication databases and network setups.
    Use tools such as:
    CANoe
    CANalyzer
    ControlDesk
    INCA
    Similar diagnostic tools
    Perform root-cause analysis of ECU, communication, and system-level issues.

HIL Operations, Maintenance & Troubleshooting

    Operate and monitor HIL benches on a daily basis.
    Manage software flashing, configuration management, and release deployment.
    Troubleshoot:
    Hardware issues
    Software issues
    Simulation model problems
    Communication-related failures
    Monitor test environment stability and resolve technical issues.
    Collaborate with development, validation, and integration teams to ensure system readiness.

ADAS & Sensor Knowledge (Meritorious)

Experience or knowledge within ADAS systems is considered an advantage.

Examples of relevant areas:

    Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)
    Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB)
    Lane Keeping Assist (LKA)
    Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR)
    Blind Spot Detection (BSD)
    Pilot Assist functions

Knowledge of sensor technologies is beneficial:

    Radar
    Camera systems
    LiDAR
    Ultrasonic sensors
    GNSS
    IMU

Experience with ADAS scenario generation and sensor simulation is highly valued.

System-Level Debugging & Technical Leadership

    Perform end-to-end debugging across:
    ECUs
    Communication networks
    Simulation models
    HIL environments
    Support definition and improvement of HIL architectures and validation strategies.
    Drive technical discussions with engineering teams and stakeholders.
    Mentor colleagues and contribute with technical guidance.
    Take ownership of complex technical challenges and drive solutions forward.

Required Qualifications

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or equivalent.
    Several years of hands-on experience in automotive HIL development and integration.
    Strong experience building and developing HIL environments.
    Proven experience with MATLAB/Simulink modelling and real-time simulation.
    Experience integrating ECUs and communication networks in HIL environments.
    Strong understanding of automotive embedded systems and vehicle validation.
    Experience with automotive communication protocols and diagnostics.
    Experience with HIL platforms such as dSPACE, Vector, ETAS, NI, or Speedgoat.
    Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
    Ability to work independently and drive technical activities.

Preferred Skills

    Experience within ADAS systems and sensor technologies.
    Experience with test automation and CI/CD environments.
    Knowledge of vehicle dynamics modelling.
    Experience from large automotive development projects.

Personal Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

    A hands-on engineer with strong technical ownership.
    Experienced in solving complex system-level problems.
    Analytical, structured, and quality-focused.
    Comfortable working cross-functionally with different engineering teams.
    Able to take initiative and drive technical improvements.
    Passionate about embedded systems, simulation, and future vehicle technologies.

Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

Start date: As agreed

Swedish Driving license B is a plus

jobs.title: Senior Embedded CI/CD Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded CI/CD Engineer with a strong background in software integration, continuous deployment, and embedded systems development.

You will join a highly skilled engineering team working with software solutions for electrified vehicles. The role focuses on developing and improving CI/CD processes, integrating embedded software components, and enabling efficient software deliveries for complex automotive systems.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection between software development, automation, integration, and future vehicle technologies.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Embedded CI/CD Engineer, you will be responsible for:

    Developing and improving software release and continuous deployment processes.
    Integrating embedded software components at application and BSW (Basic Software) level.
    Supporting and improving CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks.
    Maintaining and developing CI toolchains.
    Taking ownership of software releases and ensuring high-quality deliveries.
    Supporting automated integration testing and continuous verification.
    Working with variant management and configuration handling for different product solutions.

jobs.title: Service Delivery Lead – Cybersecurity och Identity Services
jobs.description:
Som Service Delivery Lead för Cybersecurity & Identity Services ansvarar du för våra leveranser inom cybersäkerhet och identitetstjänster inkluderat IAM. Du är den interna ägaren av våra tjänster inom cybersäkerhet och identitetshantering och fungerar som huvudsaklig kontaktpunkt gentemot vår leverantör av managerade tjänster.

I denna roll arbetar du nära interna intressenter, IT-ledningen och externa partners för att säkerställa tillförlitliga, robusta och regelmässiga säkerhetstjänster som gör det möjligt för verksamheten att bedriva sin verksamhet på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.

En viktig del av rollen är att ha en stark förmåga att beställa, styra, följa upp och förvalta outsourcade cybersäkerhetstjänster. Detta inkluderar att säkerställa kostnadseffektivitet, transparens samt att tjänsterna är i linje med företagets strategi och mål.

Det börjar med dig!

I rollen som Service Delivery Lead kommer du att:  

    Äga och följa upp tjänsteleveranser inom Cybersäkerhet, Identitet och IAM.
    Leda forum och möten för att följa upp och förbättra leveranser av IT-tjänster relativt säkerhet och compliance.
    Forma och förverkliga vår cybersäkerhetsstrategi tillsammans med övriga organisationen. Du identifierar, bedömer och prioriterar risker, samt implementerar åtgärder som matchar både verksamhetens mål och gällande regelverk.
    Övervaka hanteringen av säkerhetsincidenter och sårbarheter. Vid kritiska säkerhetsincidenter är det du som säkrar effektiv kommunikation, samordning och uppföljning.
    Säkerställa att vi alltid ligger i linje med säkerhetspolicyer, arkitekturstandarder och regulatoriska krav inom cybersäkerhet.
    Godkänna och koordinera förändringar från vår driftleverantör (MSP) för att garantera minimal affärspåverkan.
    Knyta samman arbetet med Identitet och Säkerhet med IT-drift, plattformsägare, arkitekter och ledningsgrupp.
    Tillsammans med ditt team översätta säkerhetsbehov till krav på tjänster och kommunicera risker på ett självklart sätt.
    Tillsammans med ditt team stötta funktioner som kvalitet, risk och internkontroll kring tolkning och uppföljning av krav på cybersäkerhet, direktiv, standarder och kontroller som ligger inom området för cybersäkerhet.  

Din passion för IT och verksamhet

Du är en trygg och inkluderande ledare som tar ett ägandeskap och får saker att hända. Din nyfikenhet och förmåga att skapa engagemang gör att du trivs i en roll där du har många kontaktytor. Du kommunicerar effektivt med både IT och interna kunder inom vår verksamhet.  

Vi ser också att du har:  

    God förståelse för cybersäkerhetsområdet (on-prem och cloud) och IAM såsom Identity and Access Management (IAM), SOC/SIEM, sårbarhetshantering och hantering av säkerhetsincidenter.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med leverantörer av managerade säkerhetstjänster (Managed Security Service Providers, MSSP).
    God kunskap om hur en IT-avdelning fungerar exempelvis Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management och Service Level Management.
    Förståelse för molntjänster såsom Azure AD / Entra ID, Microsoft 365, AWS med flera, samt moderna identitets- och säkerhetsarkitekturer såsom Zero Trust, Conditional Access, multifaktorautentisering (MFA) och hantering konton med höga privilegier.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med säkerhetsramverk och ledningssystem som NIST, ISO 27001 och CIS Critical Security Controls, samt kunskap om regulatoriska krav inom cybersäkerhet på verksamheter inom EU.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med leverantörer och tjänsteleverantörer.
    Flytande engelska samt goda kunskaper i svenska.

Utöver detta tror vi att du har en akademisk examen och minst fem års erfarenhet från en liknande roll. Du trivs med en kombination av strategiska och operativa arbetsuppgifter



Låter detta intressant? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning och gör bakgrundskontroll. Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

jobs.title: Integration Developer at Oatly
jobs.description:
WHY OATLY?

Across the world people’s consumption habits and diets are evolving to be more plant-based. Enter Oatly, the #1 oat based dairy alternative producer in the world with products spanning multiple categories.

We’re determined on being part of the discussion on the long-term future of the food and beverage industry. To keep this movement going, we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the Oatly flowing.

Our sole purpose as a company is to make it easy for people to turn what they eat and drink into personal moments of healthy joy without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process.

Sustainability, nutritional health and trust are at the heart of what we do. We are building a culture that constantly upgrades each other so we can upgrade the planet. This is a company that shows great respect and a fearless approach to make positive change. Does this feel exciting? Well, this is where you come in.

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO

The purpose of this role is to lead the ongoing implementation and continuous improvement of our IT integrations landscape. You’ll ensure our systems not only support but elevate our business goals, bringing strategic direction, technical know-how, and a sharp eye for value creation.

Here’s the main elements of the role...

    

Manage & maintain existing integrations

    

Be involved as the reference point in all parts of projects from an integration perspective. From requirements specification to implementation and testing

    

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and ensure successful project delivery.

    

Ensure quality and compliance through testing, validation, and regular audits, including SOX compliance and collaboration with auditors.

    

Possess advanced knowledge in Azure Integration Services and relevant extensions

But, you know. These are just the things we can think of right now! This might be the job today, but tomorrow brings more change, so being light on your feet and willing to embrace the unknown is a verrrrrry big help.

In this role, you will report into our Business Solutions & Delivery Director with a close connection to our Integration Lead. The location for this role is Malmö HQ.

This next section is for all the bullet point lovers out there...

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE

We are looking for you who have at least a Bachelor's degree in IT or a related field. We also look for someone who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset and a passion for solving complex problems. With strong communication skills and a collaborative spirit, you build trust across teams and drive results. You also bring leadership, structure, and a sharp analytical eye - plus the ability to turn technical challenges into real business value.

Other key competencies & experiences:

    

Experience in working with Azure Integration Services.

    

Experience in working with automated CI/CD pipelines, Visual Studio, Postman, and Azure ServiceBus Explorer.

    

Proficiency in working with ITIL processes, as we are a SOX-compliant company.

    

Experience with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI).

    

Understanding of the ecosystem and ownership of solutions that are bolt-on, ISVs, etc.

WHO WE NEED YOU TO BEWe think your oatsomeness is built upon the following qualities:

    

You are a passionate advocate for sustainability who strives to create societal shifts and drive the plant-based revolution.

    

You have problem-solving skills essential for identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.

    

You are a self-starter who enjoys building from scratch and implementing sustainable processes, structures, and tools.

    

You are highly collaborative and understand that our success as a company depends on our ability to work together to find innovative solutions.

    

You are an entrepreneur at heart, with the know-how to create forward momentum and the stamina to relentlessly drive the process.

    

You are comfortable with ambiguity and chaos, energized by the challenge of building something lasting that benefits both the world and its people.

To be the perfect fit for Oatly, we believe you have a thirst for knowledge and are a results-driven person with high integrity. You thrive with a hands-on approach, even in times of rapid change. Your social competence allows you to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.

Finally, we hope that you share our values and have a great interest to carry out our mission in order to make the world a little bit better. 

Another bulleted list felt redundant, so we made this page talking about all the benefits we offer to sweeten the deal of working with us before you apply – if you're curious, check out this fancy page right here!

YOUR APPLICATION

Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make.

As you can probably tell, we’re a norm-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, let’s do this together! It will be fun!

Last day of application: 6th of September.

We treat all candidates equally: If you are interested, please apply through our application system - any correspondence should come from there. This will ensure that the candidate experience is smooth and fair to everyone!

Love Oatly XOXO

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att felsöka, reparera och avhjälpa fel som uppstår ute i våra kunders lägenheter.

Således spenderar du största delen av dagen ute i våra fastigheter men vi ser också till att ses regelbundet på kontoret och är måna om att skapa trivsel och delaktighet. Som bovärd hos oss erbjuds du ett varierande jobb med stort eget ansvar. Du kommer att arbeta både självständigt och i nära samarbete med dina kollegor, i synnerhet bovärdar och biträdande förvaltare.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

    skapa och upprätthålla en bra relation till hyresgäster, entreprenörer och medarbetare
    utföra systematisk rondering enligt fastlagt schema
    planering och utförande av reparationer och löpande underhåll
    delaktig vid besiktningar vid av- och inflyttning
    hantera serviceanmälan, klagomål och reklamationer samt att återkoppla till hyresgästen
    beställa och följa upp fastighetsförnödenheter och mindre entreprenadarbete
    utföra tillsyn av ventilations-, värme och elsystem i våra fastigheter



Din profil

Vi söker dig som har gymnasieutbildning, gärna med inriktning mot, eller påbyggnad inom, teknik och/eller fastighet. Du är en händig problemlösare med kunskap och erfarenhet inom minst några av områdena, VVS, lägenhetsbesiktning, SBA, ronderingsarbete, bygg eller el. Vi tror att du gärna delar med dig av dina expertområden och lär dig om andras så kommer vi tillsammans att kunna hjälpa kunderna med det mesta. Vidare har du erfarenhet av kundnära fastighetsarbeten och har goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift. Du bör ha god vana av att arbeta i datasystem och B-körkort är ett krav.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Som bovärd styr du mycket över din tid så vi söker dig som är ansvarsfull och som kan prioritera. Du har ett stort driv och får gärna komma med idéer om hur vi kan förbättra i ditt område. Din förmåga att arbeta självständigt är god men du fungerar lika bra i grupp då vi lägger stor vikt vid att samarbeta och hjälpas åt. Vårt mål är att leverera en riktigt bra service till våra hyresgäster samtidigt som vi är affärsmässiga så vi söker dig som trivs med kundkontakt och som gillar utmaningen i att hitta lösningar som gynnar både kund och oss som företag.  



Willhems erbjudande

Hos Willhem välkomnas du till ett stabilt och långsiktigt bostadsbolag med en företagskultur som präglas av framåtanda, prestigelöshet och kollegor som månar om varandra. Vårt kunniga gäng i Göteborg kommer att ge dig den bästa starten genom att dela med sig av sin kunskap och ge dig möjlighet att både utveckla och utvecklas. Willhem vill ge dig som anställd de bästa förutsättningarna för välmående och därför erbjuder vi förmåner som friskvårdstimme och ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, kompetensutveckling och regelbundna trivselaktiviteter.

Ansökan:

Välkommen med din ansökan via http://jobb.willhem.se/ senast den 16 september. Urvalet kommer att ske löpande så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan!

Har du några frågor om tjänsten ber vi dig kontakta områdeschef Henrik Freed på telefon 031- 788 70 57 eller via e-post henrik.freed@willhem.se.

Innan erbjudande om anställning genomförs en bakgrundskontroll innehållande rättslig och ekonomisk bakgrund.



På Willhem jobbar vi för att både hus och människor ska må bra. Som ett av de ledande bostadsbolagen i Sverige är vår vision att skapa hyresbostäder där människor trivs och kan känna sig stolta över sitt boende. Huvudkontoret ligger i Göteborg och ca 310 personer arbetar idag hos Willhem. Marknadsvärdet på fastigheterna uppgår till ca 62 miljarder och ägare är Tredje och Fjärde AP-fonden. Läs mer om oss, vår historia och våra värderingar på story.willhem.se

jobs.title: Hinnoittelija/myyjä, Relove, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Nyt on loistava mahdollisuus päästä osaksi Reloven lämminhenkistä ja inspiroivaa tiimiä! Etsimme uutta työkaveria vahvistamaan second hand -toimintaamme Helsingin Punavuoren ja Töölön myymälöissä.

Relove on kotimainen, arvoihin nojaava perheyritys, joka yhdistää vastuullisen muodin, laadukkaan kahvilakulttuurin ja sydämellisen asiakaspalvelun ainutlaatuiseksi kokonaisuudeksi. Liikkeemme ovat kokonaisvaltaisia elämyksiä, jossa laatu, estetiikka ja tunnelma kohtaavat.

Hinnoittelijan tehtävässä yhdistyvät second hand -vaatteiden ja asusteiden hinnoittelu sekä myymälätyöskentely. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vahva kiinnostus muotiin, erinomainen tuotetuntemus sekä kyky tunnistaa laadukkaat ja halutut tuotteet.

Hinnoittelijan työssä arvioit asiakkaiden myyntiin tuomia vaatteita ja asusteita sekä määrittelet niille Reloven hinnoitteluperiaatteiden mukaisen myyntihinnan. Arvioinnissa huomioit muun muassa tuotteen brändin, materiaalit, laadun, kunnon, ajankohtaisuuden, sesongin, kysynnän sekä second hand -markkinan hintatason. Tavoitteena on rakentaa asiakkaidemme iloksi laadukas, kiinnostava ja kaupallisesti houkutteleva valikoima.

Hinnoittelun lisäksi työskentelet tarvittaessa myyjänä Relove Fredan ja Töölön myymälässä. Myyjän työhön kuuluu asiakaspalvelua, kassatyöskentelyä, tuotteiden esillepanoa, myymälän visuaalisesta ilmeestä huolehtimista sekä muita myymälän päivittäisiä tehtäviä. Relovessa visuaalisuus ja inspiroiva ostokokemus ovat tärkeä osa konseptiamme, joten pääset myös vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä myymälämme näyttää ja tuntuu.

Vastapainoa vaihtelevalle ja vauhdikkaalle työpäivälle tuovat ihanat asiakkaat, lämmin työyhteisö sekä mahdollisuus työskennellä vastuullisen muodin parissa. Relovessa persoonallisuus saa näkyä ja omaa osaamista sekä näkemyksiä pääsee aidosti hyödyntämään työn arjessa.

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos sinulla on

- vahva osaaminen vaatealasta, brändeistä, materiaaleista sekä niiden hintatasosta
- luontainen intohimo muotiin ja trendien seuraamiseen
- second hand -markkinan tuntemus
- kyky arvioida tuotteiden laatua, kuntoa ja jälleenmyyntiarvoa
- tarkka ja tehokas työskentelyote sekä kyky tehdä itsenäisesti päätöksiä
- positiivinen ja asiakaslähtöinen palveluasenne

Vaatealan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätön. Arvostamme ennen kaikkea käytännön vaateosaamista, second hand -tuntemusta sekä vahvaa kaupallista silmää.

Työsuhteen tiedot

- Työsuhdemuoto: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, osa-aikainen
- Työaika: 30 h / viikko, maanantaista sunnuntaihin 07-21 välisenä aikana
- Palkkaus: Kaupan alan TES, palkkaryhmä B (13,66-15,64€/h)
- Aloitus: mahdollisimman pian
- Työsuhde-edut: ePassi-edut, kattava työterveyshuolto, alennus kahvilatuotteista sekä vaatteiden myyntijaksosta Reloven myymälässä

Mikäli jaat arvomme vastuullisuudesta, edelläkävijyydestä ja lempeydestä sekä tunnet second hand -maailman omaksesi, hae mukaan joukkoomme! Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Barona toimii rekrytoinnin yhteistyökumppanina, valitut henkilöt solmivat työsuhteet Reloven kanssa.

HUOM! Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia.

Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla. Suosittelemme sinulle sopivia työpaikkoja työkokemuksesi, koulutustaustasi ja taitojesi perusteella. Barona Careers tekee työnhaustasi helpompaa kuin koskaan!
