jobs.title: Myyntipäällikkö, geotekniset tuotteet
jobs.description:
_Haluatko olla mukana kasvattamassa liiketoimintaa, joka auttaa rakentamaan kestävämpää ja turvallisempaa infraa modernien mittaus- ja tutkimusratkaisujen avulla?_

**Haemme nyt**

**Myyntipäällikköä geoteknisten tuotteiden myyntiin**

Ramuddenilla tarjoamme kokonaisvaltaisia ratkaisuja tilapäisiin liikennejärjestelyihin tietöihin, rakennustyömaille, rautateille ja muihin infraprojekteihin – suunnittelusta lupiin, vuokraukseen, myyntiin ja toteutukseen. Lisäksi myymme laajasti tuotteita liikenneturvallisuuteen ja maa- ja pohjarakentamisen mittaus-, paikannus- ja tutkimustarkoituksiin. Turvallisuus, palveluasenne ja jatkuva kehitys ovat toimintamme ytimessä.

**Myyntipäällikkönä** vastaat geoteknisten mittaus- ja tutkimuslaitteiden myynnistä, asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta. Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät aktiivinen myyntityö, uusasiakashankinta ja tuotealueen kehittäminen. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, muun myyntiorganisaation, toimittajien sekä tuotepäälliköiden kanssa.

Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat esimerkiksi erilaiset infra- ja pohjarakentamisen mittaus-, paikannus- ja tutkimuslaitteet, joita käytetään työmaiden suunnittelussa, toteutuksessa ja turvallisuuden varmistamisessa. Tehtävän ensisijainen työskentelypaikka sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta valtakunnallisen myynti- ja palveluverkoston tukeminen edellyttää myös matkustamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan kasvavaan liiketoimintaan ja tuomaan uusia ratkaisuja asiakkaidemme käyttöön

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan sekä kattavat työsuhde-edut, jotka heijastavat arvostustamme työpanostasi kohtaan

- Dynaamisen ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän ja kasvavan työympäristön, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevien projektien parissa

- Kannustavan ja mukavan työyhteisön, jossa yhteistyö ja hyvä fiilis ovat arkea


**Tehtäväsi**

- Vastaat geoteknisten mittaus- ja tutkimuslaitteiden myynnistä ja vuokrauksesta sekä huollosta

- Hankit uusia asiakkaita ja kehität pitkäjänteisesti olemassa olevia asiakkuuksia

- Tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia ja vastaat ja myyntitavoitteiden saavuttamisesta yhdessä muun myyntiorganisaation kanssa

- Osallistut messuille ja muihin tapahtumiin ja laadit tarjouksia, teet tarjouslaskentaa ja osallistut sopimusneuvotteluihin

- Vastaat kauppojen päättämisestä sekä asiakassuhteiden jatkuvasta kehittämisestä

- Seuraat markkinoiden, teknologian ja kilpailijoiden kehitystä ja hyödynnät tietoa liiketoiminnan kasvattamisessa

- Osallistut tuotevalikoiman, hinnoittelun ja saatavuuden kehittämiseen yhteistyössä tuoteryhmävastaavan, toimittajien ja johdon kanssa

- Koulutat ja tuet muuta myyntiorganisaatiota geotuotteiden myynnissä


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Kokemusta teknisten tuotteiden B2B-myynnistä, uusasiakashankinnasta ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä

- Kykyä tunnistaa asiakastarpeita ja rakentaa niiden pohjalta liiketoimintaa

- Ymmärrystä geoteknisistä mittaus- ja tutkimuslaitteista tai muista teknisistä ratkaisuista

- Kokemusta tarjouslaskennasta, hinnoittelusta ja sopimusneuvotteluista

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

jobs.description:
Technický a provozní specialista / specialistka

(vhodné pro OZP | HPP - plný i zkrácený úvazek | Ostrava | nástup ihned / dohodou)

Společnost Scenario s.r.o. patří mezi přední hráče na trhu informačních technologií. Na trhu působíme již více než 10 let, máme přibližně 50 zaměstnanců a působíme po celé České republice. Právě teď hledáme nového kolegu, který nám pomůže udržet provoz firmy hladký, techniku v chodu a kancelář v dobré kondici.

Baví vás práce s počítačem, mobilem a technikou obecně, ale zároveň se nezaleknete vyzvednutí balíku, cesty na poštu nebo rychlého nákupu? Hledáme posilu, která zvládne jak drobnou IT podporu, tak provozní činnosti potřebné pro chod firmy.

Tato pozice je vhodná také pro osoby se zdravotním znevýhodněním (OZP). Nabízíme přizpůsobené prostředí a vstřícný přístup od prvního dne.

Co budete dělat?
- instalovat a nastavovat PC, notebooky a mobilní telefony
- řešit drobné opravy a technickou podporu kolegů
- řešit provozní požadavky - příprava a zasílání zásilek, příležitostné nákupy
- pomáhat s chodem kanceláří a spolupracovat s kolegy napříč týmy

Co by vám nemělo chybět?
- řidičský průkaz sk. B
- základní znalosti IT (Windows, Android/iOS, kancelářské aplikace)
- šikovnost, operativnost a chuť se učit novým věcem
- spolehlivost, samostatnost a dobrá organizace práce
- technické vzdělání nebo praxe v IT výhodou
- zkušenost s instalací počítače a počítačových komponent

Co nabízíme?
- Hlavní pracovní poměr - možnost plného i zkráceného úvazku podle vašich možností
- různorodou práci kombinující technické i provozní úkoly
- Přátelské a lidské prostředí, kde vám pomůžeme růst
- Práci od pondělí do pátku - víkendy a svátky volné
- Notebook a telefon i pro vaše soukromé potřeby
- Zaučení a podpora během celého adaptačního procesu
- Vzdělávání a možnost profesního růstu
- Firemní a týmové akce
- Kvalitní káva zdarma, dostupnost MHD i možnost pohodlného parkování

Proč právě k nám?

Protože u nás nebudete jen "technik" nebo "řidič". Hledáme kolegu či kolegyni, který dokáže zajistit, že vše funguje - od počítačů přes mobily až po balíky. U nás najdete podporu, prostor pro nápady i tým, na který se můžete spolehnout.


Zaujala vás tato nabídka?
Pošlete nám svůj životopis na kariera@scenario.cz

Těšíme se na vás!

jobs.title: Sociální pracovník/pracovnice - vedoucí nízkoprahového zařízení pro děti a mládež, Ostatní odborní pracovníci v sociální oblasti
jobs.description:
Hledáme sociálního pracovníka, který je plný energie do práce s dětmi, mladými lidmi a zároveň má chuť vést malý tým a hledat nové cesty pro další rozvoj nízkoprahového zařízení pro děti a mládež ve Velkém Meziříčí.
Co děláme ve Wellmezu?
Poskytujeme podporu dětem a dospívajícím, ve věku 8 - 26 let, kteří se ocitli v situaci, ve které jim nemá kdo pomoci. Pro naše uživatele vytváříme bezpečné prostředí, kde se mohou důvěrně svěřovat.
Jaká je náplň práce vedoucího?
- vede malý tým pracovníků
- zodpovídá za kvalitu služby včetně tvorby metodik
- reaguje na aktuální potřeby uživatelů a podle nich službu dál rozvíjí
- pracuje s uživateli na klubu (v prostorách zařízení) nebo v terénu (ulicích města)
- jedná se zájemci o službu, uzavírá smlouvy, vytváří individuální plány průběhu služby
- spolupracuje s dalšími organizacemi a subjekty (školy, OSPOD, SVP, Policie...)
- účastní se různých pracovních skupin v rámci organizace, města i Kraje Vysočina
- ve spolupráci s PR pracovníkem se stará o dobrou prezentaci služby
- spolupracuje při tvorbě rozpočtu a pak zajišťuje jeho správné čerpání
- zodpovídá za prostory služby (má k dispozici údržbáře a uklízečku) a další provozní záležitosti
Kde?
ve Velkém Meziříčí, na Hornoměstské ulici č. 366/41 (vedle Billy)
Od kdy?
nástup dle oboustranné domluvy
Co nabízíme?
- pracovní smlouvu na plný úvazek
- akční, smysluplnou a kreativní práci - jistotu, že se v práci nebudete nudit
- prostor pro přinášení vlastních nápadů
- dobré zaučení a průběžné odborné vedení
- pravidelné sdílení s kolegy z našich dalších dvou nízkoprahů
- kvalitní průběžné vzdělávání (kursy, konference, stáže), pravidelnou supervizi
- pomoc a podporu při zajišťování ekonomických a dalších záležitostí souvisejících s provozem služby
- zaměstnanecké benefity (stravenkovou kartu, týden dovolené navíc, další jednorázové finanční i nefinanční benefity)
- zázemí stabilní organizace, pro kterou jsou její zaměstnanci důležití
Hledáme kolegu, který
- má vzdělání potřebné pro pozici sociálního pracovníka (min. VOŠ),
- je plný energie a nadšení pro práci s dětmi a mladými dospívajícími lidmi,

jobs.description:
Vedoucí ekonomického úseku (m/ž)
Mzda: 50000–70000 Kč / měsíc
Místo: Auto Dobrovolný V.M.
Auto Dobrovolný je rodinná firma s více než 30letou tradicí a třemi provozovnami – Velké Meziříčí, Jihlava a Znojmo. Zastupujeme značky Škoda, Opel, MG a LEAPmotor a zakládáme si na férovém přístupu a stabilním zázemí pro 90 zaměstnanců.
Koho hledáme
Hledáme zkušeného člověka, který převezme odpovědnost za ekonomický úsek a kompletní účetnictví společnosti. Důležitá je samostatnost, schopnost vést menší tým, organizovat práci a mít věci systémově pod kontrolou. Čeká náš velká modernizace systémů ve firmě, takže je pozice vhodná pro energického člověka, který se nebojí výzev, chopí se tohoto projektu a vystaví si finanční oddělení dle svých preferencí.
Při nástupu vás seznámíme s interními procesy a účetním systémem Softapp, kompletní agendu převezmete postupně.
Náplň práce
•    Kompletní vedení účetnictví společnosti v souladu s platnou legislativou, včetně agendy DPH a DPPO.
•    Odpovědnost za měsíční a roční účetní uzávěrky.
•    Vedení, koordinace a metodická podpora účetního týmu o čtyřech lidech.
•    Aktivní zapojení do implementace nového účetního systému a nastavení souvisejících procesů.
•    Příprava podkladů pro auditora a daňového poradce, komunikace s finančním úřadem a dalšími institucemi.
•    Vedení evidence dlouhodobého majetku, odpisů a inventarizací.
•    Tvorba ekonomických přehledů, reportů a analýz pro vedení společnosti.
•    Průběžné nastavování, vyhodnocování a optimalizace účetních a ekonomických procesů; pokročilá práce v Excelu.
•    Občasné služební cesty na další provozovny Auto Dobrovolný v Jihlavě a Znojmě.

Požadavky
•    Praxe na pozici hlavní / samostatné účetní min. 5 let
•    Výborná znalost českých účetních předpisů a daňové legislativy
•    Zkušenost s ročními uzávěrkami a komunikací s auditory výhodou
•    Zkušenost s digitalizací účetních systémů velkou výhodou
•    Znalost práce v účetních systémech (u nás Softapp) a velmi dobrá orientace v MS Excel
•    Schopnost vést tým, nastavovat procesy a dotahovat úkoly v termínech
•    Pečlivost, zodpovědnost a samostatnost
•    Řidičský průkaz
Co nabízíme
•    Flexibilní pracovní dobu
•    Podnikovou jídelnu s příspěvkem na stravu
•    5 sick days ročně
•    Vstupenky na sportovní a kulturní akce
•    Výhodný nákup nového vozu a slevy na servisní úkony

jobs.title: Specialist Klantcontact ING en NN (Hybride werken)
jobs.description:
Voor deze dubbele rol zoeken we kandidaten met aantoonbare ervaring in telefonisch klantcontact of een servicegerichte omgeving. Ervaring in de banken- of verzekeringssector is een pre, maar geen vereiste. Belangrijker is dat je snel kunt schakelen tussen verschillende geavanceerde computersystemen, communicatief sterk bent en plezier hebt in het oplossen van uiteenlopende klantvragen. Je wordt uitgebreid ingewerkt.

Werk voor twee van de grootste financiele merken van Nederland!

Ben jij op zoek naar een afwisselende en inhoudelijke baan in de financiele sector? En wil jij je cv een enorme boost geven door ervaring op te doen bij zowel ING als Nationale Nederlanden? Als Klantcontact Medewerker ben jij de verbindende factor voor de klanten van deze topmerken. Een functie vol dynamiek, groei en afwisseling!

Jouw werkplek: ING en Nationale Nederlanden (via Tempo Team)
Je komt te werken in een professionele, moderne en innovatieve werkomgeving. Zowel ING als Nationale Nederlanden staan bekend om hun mensgerichte cultuur en uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden. Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en enthousiast team dat elkaar helpt en versterkt.

De functie en jouw uitdagingen
In deze rol help je klanten met uiteenlopende vragen over financiele producten en diensten van ING en Nationale Nederlanden. Omdat je voor twee grote merken werkt, is geen dag hetzelfde en blijf je jezelf continu uitdagen.

Jouw uitdagingen in deze rol:

Schakelen tussen verschillende systemen en merken: Je duikt snel in de achterliggende klantsystemen van zowel ING als NN om de situatie van de klant helder te krijgen.

Inhoudelijke en klantgerichte service verlenen: Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt, luistert actief naar de klantvraag en geeft een helder en deskundig antwoord.

Continu jezelf blijven ontwikkelen: Je volgt uitgebreide, betaalde trainingen en leert de fijne kneepjes van het financiele vak, wat jou een ijzersterke basis geeft voor de toekomst.

Wil jij aan de slag in een veelzijdige functie bij twee absolute marktleiders? Reageer dan direct en start jouw carriere via Tempo Team!

jobs.title: Secretarieel medewerker
jobs.description:
Vind jij het leuk om administratieve taken uit te voeren, hou je van afwisseling en ervoor zorgen dat alles administratief goed geregeld is? Dan is deze functie als secretarieel medewerker iets voor jou!

Deze positie is opengesteld voor iemand die valt onder de participatiewet: voor personen met een bijstandsuitkering of voor mensen die in het doelgroepregister Banenafspraak staan.

Dit zijn je belangrijkste werkzaamheden:
- Agenda's beheren en plannen van afspraken
- Afstemmen van afspraken met collega's en externe contacten
- Zorgen dat de werkzaamheden goed op elkaar aansluiten
- Overzicht houden over wat er moet gebeuren en wanneer
- Opstellen en verwerken van e-mails, brieven en documenten
- Teksten netjes en compleet maken, ook als je alleen een opzet krijgt
- Bijhouden van inkomende en uitgaande e-mails
- Plannen van vergaderingen en zorgen dat alles geregeld is: ruimte, deelnemers en stukken
- Agenda's opstellen en voorbereiden van overleggen
- Notuleren tijdens overleggen en uitwerken van aantekeningen
- Actiepunten bewaken, en indien nodig, herinneringen aan collega's
- Verwerken en bijhouden van administratie en archiveren van (online) gegevens

Wat vragen we van jou?
We zoeken iemand die betrouwbaar is, afspraken nakomt en:
- Administratieve en secretariële werkzaamheden kan uitvoeren
- Kan werken met basisprogramma's van Office365 zoals e-mail, Outlook en Word
- Over goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal beschikt, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
- Werk kan organiseren en overzicht kan houden over meerdere, verschillende taken
- Afspraken kan plannen en zorgt dat agenda's overzichtelijk en actueel zijn

jobs.description:
← Back to blog Blog How Do You Apply for Child Benefits or Allowances as a Migrant Worker?
24 November 2025 3 min read
If you work in the Netherlands and your children live here or in your home country, you may be entitled to child benefits or other allowances in some cases. This can be an important financial support for families living in the Netherlands or where a parent works here. But how does it work for migrant workers? And how do you apply for it? In this blog, Charlie works explains it step by step. Child Benefits in the Netherlands
Child benefits are a financial contribution from the Dutch government to help with the costs of raising children. This scheme is administered by the Social Insurance Bank (SVB) .
You are entitled to child benefits if: - You live or work in the Netherlands, - Your children are under 18 years old, - And you pay premiums for Dutch national insurance.
Even if your children live in another EU country, you may often be entitled to (partial) child benefits. This depends on your personal situation and whether your partner also works.
More information can be found at SVB - Child Benefits . How Do You Apply for Child Benefits?
If you work through Charlie works, you are usually automatically registered with the Dutch authorities. However, you must apply for child benefits yourself. Here's how: - Make sure you are registered with the municipality : You need a BSN (Citizen Service Number). - Create a DigiD : With DigiD, you can securely log in to government websites. Learn how it works at www.digid.nl . - Go to the SVB website : Log in via My SVB with your DigiD. - Fill in the child benefits application : Provide the details of your children, even if they live in another country.
After your application, you will receive a notification from the SVB. If you are entitled to child benefits, you will receive it four times a year. Other Allowances in the Netherlands

Climate change is one of the greatest challenges for global food security, requiring new approaches to understand and harness the natural diversity that enables plants and their associated microbiomes to adapt to environmental change. Ancient environmental DNA (eDNA) provides a unique record of past ecosystems, preserving genetic traces of microorganisms and plants that interacted with crops and their wild relatives over thousands of years. In this project, you will develop and apply computational omics approaches to uncover the molecular mechanisms underlying ancient plant-microbiome interactions, with a particular focus on biosynthetic gene clusters and other functional genes involved in chemical communication, defence, and adaptation. You will analyse large-scale ancient metagenomic datasets to identify and characterize microbial and plant-derived biosynthetic pathways, predict their ecological functions, and reconstruct the (co-)evolutionary dynamics of traits such as microbiome recruitment, metabolite-mediated interactions, pathogenicity and disease resistance. This will involve using and further adapting state-of-the-art genome mining approaches, including biosynthetic gene cluster identification, gene cluster family classification, and functional prediction, to work with highly fragmented and complex eDNA datasets.

jobs.title: Service Technician
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with your hands, like variety in your job, and want to see the results of your work every day? At Amtra Mobiele Ruimte, you'll work on a wide range of projects across the Benelux. One day you'll be assembling modular units on-site, the next you'll be carrying out maintenance or coordinating a team of technicians. No two days are the same. Earn between €2,700 and €3,700 gross per month while building your future with a growing family-owned company. What’s your job about? As a Service Technician / Site Supervisor, you will be responsible for assembling, dismantling, maintaining and delivering modular units at customer locations. You will work independently or together with colleagues on a variety of projects, ensuring everything is completed safely, efficiently and to a high standard. Your responsibilities include: Assembling, dismantling and maintaining modular units; Installing walls, doors, locks and fittings; Performing carpentry, sawing, painting and finishing work; Installing electrical wiring and lighting; Making units windproof and watertight; Coordinating technicians and maintenance activities on-site; Reading CAD drawings and translating them into practical execution; Managing construction and installation materials. What skills do you have? You are a practical and motivated professional who enjoys taking responsibility. You like working at different locations and get energy from hands-on technical work. In addition, you have: MBO-level education or equivalent, preferably in a technical field; Experience in assembly, construction, installation or technical maintenance; A valid category B driving licence; A VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one; The ability to read technical drawings, or the motivation to learn; A good command of the English language (Dutch is considered an advantage); A customer-focused, accurate and solution-oriented mindset. What do you get in return? A gross monthly salary between €2,700 and €3,700, depending

on your experience and skills; A full-time position within a stable and growing family-owned company; A varied job with projects across the Netherlands and Belgium; Opportunities to follow technical training courses and obtain certifications; Excellent career development opportunities; Competitive primary and secondary employment conditions; A friendly and informal working environment where colleagues support each other. Amtra B.V. specialises in the rental and installation of modular units for both temporary and long-term accommodation solutions. From its Dutch branch, the company delivers projects throughout the Benelux. Amtra is part of a German family-owned business with more than 25 years of experience. Quality, teamwork and short communication lines are at the heart of the organisation. You'll join an informal team where people work hard, help each other and enjoy building impressive projects together.

Learn a technical trade and work directly in practice
Would you like to work in a technical field and get a diploma at the same time? The BBL machining course at Brans Metaalbewerking combines learning and working.
You will gain practical experience in our modern workshop and attend classes one day a week to learn the theory.
This is how you will quickly grow into a skilled machinist.
What is a BBL training program?
BBL stands for Beroeps Begeleidende Leerweg. This is an apprenticeship in which you will: -
Works four days a week at Brans Metalworking -
Attends school one day a week -
Receive a salary during your training
You immediately apply the theory you learn at school in practice. As a result, you learn faster and understand the subject better.
What does machining involve?
Machining involves using tools contained in a (CNC) machine to remove material in a controlled manner until you have created a nice product that has the desired shape and size. The pieces of material removed are also called "chips" (shavings).
Metalworking is a beautiful and interesting profession in which you are busy making a top product from a starting material for your customer. You start by making a drawing or a step file (3D model) using Cad/Cam software to program as many operations as possible (drilling, tapping, milling, deburring) in one go on your CNC machine. Then you put the tools in the machine and start machining the product. BBL opleiding verspanen bij Brans Metaalbewerking
What will you learn during the course?
During your BBL trajectory at Brans Metaalbewerking you will develop step by step the skills you need as a machinist: -

PhD Community
The PhD Community at the Rudolf Agricola School is a vibrant network of 60 early-career researchers tackling the complex challenges of sustainable development from an inter- and transdisciplinary perspective. It provides a supportive space for collaboration and knowledge exchange.
What do you offer?
As a member, you will have access to a variety of activities designed to enrich your research journey. These include hands-on workshops on interdisciplinary methods, opportunities to apply to grant proposals, and informal networking events (including drinks!)) where you can exchange ideas with peers and meet other researchers working on similar topics. Last year, we organized two training workshops, on interdisciplinarity and societal impact , as well as several informal gatherings.
Who can join?
Our community welcomes any PhD candidates whose research relates to sustainable development. We particularly encourage those working at the intersection of disciplines or in collaboration with societal partners to be part of our network.
How to join?
To join our PhD community you must simply become a Fellow and you will automatically be part of our PhD Community.
Whether you want to broaden your academic horizons, collaborate across disciplines, or simply connect with others navigating the (inter- and transdisciplinary) PhD experience, the PhD Community at the Rudolf Agricola School is the perfect place to start!

jobs.title: Sales Recruiter
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sales Recruiter you’ll help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization. You’ll recruit for new and evolving customer-facing roles—including Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, and Forward Deployed Engineers—that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner with Sales leaders and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires.

You will use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for. You will also help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build trusted partnerships with Sales leaders, advising on role definition, search strategy, assessment design, and hiring decisions for new and evolving teams.

 - Deliver high-quality hires across the next generation of GTM roles, from sourcing through close, while creating a thoughtful, inclusive, and high-touch candidate experience.

 - Translate Notion’s product love, AI opportunity, and customer motion into accurate candidate narratives that help the right people self-select in.

 - Use talent-market research, mapping, and recruiting data to improve hiring strategy and decision quality.

 - Raise the quality and consistency of the hiring system through structured intake, calibration, debriefs, manager coaching, and sourcing strategies that expand representation.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated success recruiting across GTM searches, with the judgment to learn and represent evolving role profiles accurately.

 - Ability to turn business strategy into clear candidate profiles, search plans, and objective assessment criteria—and to influence senior leaders toward strong decisions.

 - Strong sourcing, market-mapping, and closing instincts across various Sales disciplines.

 - Operational rigor and comfort using data to diagnose pipeline health, measure impact, and improve the candidate and hiring-manager experience.

 - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools: you use them to think better, improve recruiting workflows, and make your work easier for others to build on. 

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: geologo/geologa
jobs.description: Wyser Srl è la società internazionale di Gi Group che si occupa di ricerca e selezione di middle e senior management specializzato. Facciamo parte di Gi Group, una delle principali realtà a livello internazionale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Per cliente leader di mercato, posizionato a Bologna, ricerchiamo un/una CLOUD OPERATION/SPECIALISTA PIATTAFORMA GEN AI La risorsa fornirà supporto alle operazioni e alla governance delle piattaforme aziendali di IA generativa (ad esempio, Microsoft Azure, Copilot Studio), garantendo l'affidabilità, la sicurezza e la qualità del servizio degli agenti di IA in produzione. l ruolo, all'interno dell'area di Enterprise Systems Management, lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team di IA, i team di Technology Enterprise Solutions & Services e Cloud Operations, contribuendo all'abilitazione operativa delle piattaforme GenAI, al monitoraggio dei servizi e al miglioramento continuo dei processi operativi. Responsabilità - Gestire la configurazione operativa delle piattaforme GenAI (Azure / Copilot), comprese le impostazioni dei tenant, i servizi, le integrazioni e le connessioni necessarie per l'adozione degli agenti di IA; - Supportare i team di IA durante le fasi di onboarding e configurazione, fornendo indicazioni sui prerequisiti tecnici, sulle configurazioni e sulle migliori pratiche operative; - Collaborare con i team di sicurezza e conformità per mitigare i rischi legati all'accesso ai dati tramite gli agenti di IA; - Contribuire alla distribuzione degli agenti AI, garantendo la prontezza operativa, le checklist di go-live e il supporto nella definizione di SLA/SLO; - Implementare e gestire le attività di monitoraggio e osservabilità (metriche, dashboard, avvisi), supportando l'analisi delle anomalie e del degrado del servizio; - Partecipare alla gestione del ciclo di vita operativo (incidenti, problemi, modifiche, rilasci), in linea con i processi aziendali di IT Operations; - Collaborare con i team Cloud Ops / FinOps sulla pianificazione della capacità e la consapevolezza dei costi, monitorando le tendenze di utilizzo e i potenziali rischi; - Mantenere e aggiornare la documentazione operativa (runbook, procedure, FAQ tecniche), favorendo la condivisione delle conoscenze. Requisiti - Esperienza in ruoli legati alle operazioni IT, alle operazioni cloud in contesti aziendali o multinazionali - Buona conoscenza di Microsoft Azure (gestione tenant/identità, servizi di base, registrazione e monitoraggio) e familiarità con le piattaforme Copilot 365 / Copilot Studio; - Buona conoscenza di Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps); - Esperienza nelle operazioni di servizi IT: gestione degli incidenti, risoluzione dei problemi, analisi delle cause alla radice (RCA) e gestione degli SLA; - Mentalità collaborativa e orientata al servizio, con la capacità di lavorare con team interfunzionali e tradurre le esigenze tecniche e aziendali in azioni operative; - Approccio strutturato, con particolare attenzione alla stabilità del servizio e al miglioramento continuo. Competenze gradite - Esperienza operativa di base con AWS o ambienti multi-cloud; - Familiarità con strumenti di osservabilità (ad es. Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights o soluzioni simili); - Conoscenza dei principi SRE / di affidabilità del servizio (SLO, indicatori di qualità del servizio); - Esperienza con piattaforme low-code, automazione dei flussi di lavoro o piattaforme di IA/agenti, anche al di fuori di contesti puramente di sviluppo. Sede di lavoro: Bologna con possibilità di smart working. Si offre: Contratto a tempo indeterminato CCNL applicato: CCNL Commercio Livello di inquadramento: 1°-2° Fascia di retribuzione prevista: 50/55.000 € lordi annui Sono inoltre previsti premi di risultato, ticket restaurant Wyser (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) #LI-RR

jobs.description: Per solida realtà in espansione con sede a Genova, appartenente ad una multinazionale svizzera, produttore leader nel settore della strumentazione per l'analisi in continuo delle acque, in un'ottica di potenziamento del proprio organico è alla ricerca di un * KEY ACCOUNT NORD ITALIA - SETTORE CHIMICO La risorsa sarà responsabile dello sviluppo commerciale e della vendita B2B di strumentazione per analisi chimiche e chimico-fisiche in continuo, rivolta al settore trattamento acque, nello specifico ai mercati Power, Acqua Potabile, Farmaceutico, Industriale, Semiconduttori. RUOLO Riportando direttamente al Sales Manager, la figura ricoprirà un ruolo dinamico e orientato al territorio, avrà ampia autonomia nella gestione commerciale dell'area assegnata, con focus sul consolidamento dei rapporti con i clienti esistenti e sullo sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business, operando secondo un approccio consulenziale, e avrà responsabilità diretta sui risultati. Tra le sue principali responsabilità: - Gestire e fidelizzare il portafoglio clienti attivo, creando partnership di lungo periodo. - Sviluppare il business nelle aree assegnate e incrementare il portafoglio, aumentando vendite e fatturato. - Identificare nuovi clienti e nuove opportunità nei mercati in crescita, con focus sul farmaceutico. - Indagare opportunità su nuovi mercati (es. Data Center, Idrogeno) - Preparare offerte commerciali e seguire l'intero ciclo di vendita fino alla chiusura. - Definire e proporre il budget vendite annuale, monitorando KPI e performance commerciali. - Collaborare con il team Marketing per la pianificazione di attività di promozione dei prodotti e di sviluppo del mercato. - Partecipare a fiere, eventi di settore e incontri strategici con clienti. - Aggiornare con puntualità CRM ed ERP aziendale Il profilo ricercato: Necessaria formazione ad indirizzo scientifico (preferibilmente laurea), con preparazione chimica di base. Esperienza di almeno 3 anni in ruoli commerciali B2B, maturata preferibilmente in aziende di settori affini Inglese fluente Buona conoscenza dei mercati di riferimento. Forte orientamento allo sviluppo business e alla negoziazione. Ottime doti organizzative ed autonomia operativa. Forte motivazione e determinazione nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali. Il ruolo prevede disponibilità a frequenti trasferte nella zona assegnata Lombardia, Piemonte, Liguria e Valle d'Aosta (fino al 70-75%) e, occasionalmente, in altre aree in Italia e in Svizzera. COSA OFFRIAMO Inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato. RAL 35-40k, commisurata all'esperienza. Importante sistema incentivante variabile legato a obiettivi commerciali chiari e misurabili. Auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo. Buoni pasto da 8 Euro. Assicurazione infortuni professionale ed extra professionale Autonomia nella gestione del lavoro. Percorso di crescita tramite formazione personale, professionale e tecnica continua. Supporto tecnico interno costante. Contesto professionale serio e collaborativo, in ambiente modernamente organizzato. Possibilità di lavorare da remoto SEDE DI LAVORO: Nord Italia (Lombardia, Piemonte, Liguria, Valle d'Aosta). #LI-GS2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. jobs.title: Procurement Lead Buyer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Procurement Lead Buyer (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.

Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg

We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.
In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.

What you will be working on

• Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
• Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
• Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
• Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.
• Identify, evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost and reliability.
• Lead sourcing activities including RFPs, RFQs and supplier negotiations.
• Manage purchase orders and monitor delivery performance.

‎
Group Financial Controller

Reporting directly to the CFO, the role will help build scalable financial governance, robust reporting, and efficient processes across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices.
The successful candidate will play a central role in developing the financial infrastructure required to support the Group's international growth, ensuring reliable financial information, strengthening compliance with laws and regulations, and establishing a consistent reporting and control framework. The role will also act as the single Finance point of contact for the partner responsible for the Group's foreign offices.

Your role:

Treasury Management

• Lead and oversee treasury management activities, supported by one full-time team member, including cash flow monitoring, liquidity planning, banking relationships, and related controls.
Financial reporting & consolidation
• Review monthly accounting close activities and ensure the timely and accurate preparation of monthly management reporting across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices.
• Implement the group financial consolidation process, including methodology, timetable, reporting framework, and quality controls.

Compliance

• Ensure compliance with all applicable local laws and regulations, including accounting, statutory, and tax obligations.
• Review and redesign the Group's transfer pricing policies, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and evolving business operations.

Internal controls/process

• Optimise finance and accounting processes across the Group, with a particular focus on foreign offices, to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
• Contribute to the development of internal controls, policies, and procedures to support a robust finance governance framework.

Stakeholder & External Provider Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers, including accountants, tax advisers, auditors and other finance-related partners.
• Act as the key Finance contact for the partner responsible for foreign offices, providing financial insight, coordination, and support on cross-border matters.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across offices to ensure consistent financial processes, reporting standards, and information flows.

Your profile:

• Qualified finance professional, ideally with a degree in finance, accounting, audit, or a related discipline.
• Proven ability to supervise, guide, and develop at least one finance team member while remaining hands-on in day-to-day financial operations.
• Significant experience in financial control, audit or group reporting, preferably in a professional services, law firm, or multi-entity international environment.
• Experience with treasury management, tax compliance, transfer pricing, and financial consolidation in a multi-GAAP environment.
• Strong understanding of internal controls, process improvement, and finance governance frameworks.
• Hands-on, structured, and pragmatic mindset, with the ability to build processes in a newly created role.
• Experience in cross-functional roles, with the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across offices and seniority levels.
• Excellent communication skills in English; French would be an advantage.
• High standards of integrity, discretion, and professionalism, consistent with a law firm environment.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Infrastructure Security (Cyber-Security-Consultant)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Manager, Infrastructure Security. In this pivotal role, you will lead the strategy for protecting our cloud and corporate environments by reducing real-world risk without slowing down the business. You will champion a "Secure by Design" philosophy, ensuring that security is a collaborative engineering challenge where automated guardrails and technical excellence enable our platform to scale rapidly and securely by default.

As a Senior Manager, you will build and lead a mission-oriented team of engineers, fostering a culture where technical excellence, automation, and professional growth are central to our operations. You will move away from reactive auditing, instead focusing on the engineering of non-negotiable technical gates that prevent misconfiguration at the source. Your leadership will be defined by the ability to co-design the "how" with Engineering and IT, co-authoring architectural blueprints that are technically viable and operationally frictionless. By driving the transition toward Security-as-Code and consistent enforcement across 100% of our assets, you will directly influence the resilience and velocity of the world’s leading local delivery platform.

- Lead and Mentor a High-Performing Team: Champion a culture of technical excellence and professional growth, enabling the team to drive strategic infrastructure resilience and long-term career success.
- Drive Infrastructure Security Maturity: Define the strategic roadmap for our core domains to ensure maximum risk reduction and operational efficiency across our global cloud and corporate infrastructure.

jobs.title: (Senior) Netzingenieur*in (gn) im Produktmanagement digitaler Netzzwilling (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen nicht zwingend eine fertige Produktmanagerin und keinen fertigen Produktmanager. Wir suchen Netz-Know-how.

Darum geht es:

Wir bauen mit der gaia powergrids Modulsuite einen digitalen Zwilling des Stromnetzes: eine Plattform, die Verteilnetzbetreiber unter anderem bei der Anschlussprüfung und der Zielnetzplanung unterstützt – dort also, wo heute Excel, Erfahrungswerte und lange Wartezeiten für Anschlusskunden aufeinandertreffen.

Für die Weiterentwicklung dieser Modulsuite suchen wir eine Person, die Netzpraxis mitbringt und mit dem Produktmanagement die fachlichen Konzepte erstellt, validiert und das Anforderungsmanagement dafür übernimmt. Du weißt, wie ein Netz wirklich geplant, gerechnet und bewertet wird – und übersetzt dieses Wissen in ein Produkt, das Netzbetreiber täglich nutzen.

‍

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

- Federführung für die fachlichen Konzepte der neuen powergrids Module – von der ersten Idee über die Validierung mit Kund*innen bis zur abgestimmten Spezifikation.
- Fachliche Instanz für elektrotechnische und planerische Fragestellungen rund um das Produkt – du stellst sicher, dass unsere Verfahren dem Stand der Technik entsprechen und in der Praxis der Netzbetreiber tragen.
- Anforderungsmanagement: Anforderungen aus Kundenprojekten, Markt, Regulatorik und Datenanalysen strukturiert sammeln, schärfen und priorisieren.
- Übersetzen fachlicher Anforderungen in Konzepte, User Journeys und technische Spezifikationen – gemeinsam mit Engineering, Data Science und Design.
- Fachliche Bewertung von Netzmodellen, Netztopologien, Berechnungsverfahren, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen – und Ableiten klarer Produktentscheidungen.
- Einbringen deiner Netzperspektive in Produktstrategie und Roadmap, gemeinsam mit Product Owner und Produktleitung.
- Enger Austausch mit Pilotkund*innen, Partner*innen sowie unseren Kolleg*innen aus Sales und Customer Success.

‍

Das bringst du mit:

- Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium – Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen mit energietechnischer Vertiefung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Praxiserfahrung bei oder für einen Verteilnetzbetreiber bzw. Energieversorger in einer technischen Rolle mit Stromnetzbezug – also auch, wenn du diese Erfahrung als Dienstleister*in, im Ingenieurbüro oder in der Beratung gesammelt hast.

Zum Beispiel als:

- Netzplaner*in oder Grundsatzplaner*in (Mittel- und/oder Niederspannung)
- Netzberechner*in
- Ingenieur*in im Netzanschluss- oder Kundenanschlussprozess
- Asset Manager*in
- Mitarbeiter*in in Netzbetrieb, Betriebsführung oder Netzführung
- Projektierer*in oder Ingenieur*in in Netzdokumentation / GIS
- Fundiertes technisches Netzverständnis: Du kennst das Stromnetz und seine Betriebsmittel im Detail. Lastfluss- und Kurzschlussberechnungen kannst du einordnen und interpretieren – oder du bringst die Grundlagen mit, um dich schnell darin einzuarbeiten.
- Idealerweise hast du selbst schon Anschlussprüfungen für neue Anlagen in mindestens einer Spannungsebene durchgeführt und/oder eine Zielnetzplanung erstellt.
- Ein Gespür dafür, welche technischen Fragen ein Netzbetreiber beantworten muss, bevor er einen Anschluss zusagt oder einen Netzausbau beschließt.
- Analytisches, datengetriebenes Denken und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
- Freude daran, Komplexität verständlich zu machen und Entscheidungen voranzutreiben.
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; gutes Englisch.

‍

Schön, wenn du es mitbringst – kein Muss

- Vertrautheit mit den einschlägigen Regelwerken zur Bewertung neuer Anschlussbegehren – in Deutschland z. B. VDE-AR-N 4100/4105/4110/4120 und die TAB, in der Schweiz die entsprechenden Werke von VSE und Netzbetreibern.
- Erfahrung mit Netzberechnungssoftware (z. B. PowerFactory, Integral, NEPLAN, pandapower, Sincal).
- Kenntnisse regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen in Deutschland und/oder der Schweiz (z. B. Netzanschluss, Ausbauplanung, EEG/Redispatch, Anschlussbegehren-Prozesse).
- Verständnis von Schnittstellen und Systemlandschaften beim Netzbetreiber (GIS, ERP, Leitsystem).
- Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, mit agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) oder in Softwareprojekten.
- Interesse/Know-how, wie KI, Simulationen und Datenmodelle in Softwareprodukte einfließen.
- Offene, positive Persönlichkeit, die den Austausch liebt und Freude an einem modernen, kooperativen Arbeitsumfeld hat.
- Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – du kannst technische Zusammenhänge so erklären, dass Engineering, Design und Vertrieb sie gleichermaßen verstehen.
- Hohe Motivation, sinnvolle Entscheidungen voranzutreiben.
- Spaß an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit – von Engineering bis Sales.

‍

Auch wenn du noch nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst:

Vielleicht hast du noch nie eine Roadmap gepflegt, kein Backlog priorisiert und noch nie das Wort „User Journey" benutzt. Das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du in einer technischen Rolle beim Netzbetreiber gearbeitet hast, das Netz und seine Prozesse wirklich kennst und Lust hast, dein Wissen in ein digitales Produkt einzubringen statt in die nächste Anschlussprüfung im Einzelfall – dann bewirb dich. Wir bringen dir das Produkthandwerk bei; dein Netz-Know-how können wir nicht ersetzen.

Wir bieten als IT-Dienstleistungsgruppe alle Kernelemente der digitalen Wertschöpfungskette aus einer Hand – von Beratungsprojekten über Softwareentwicklung bis hin zu IT-Betriebsszenarien. - Unterstützung bei Erd-, Tiefbau- und Landschaftsbauarbeiten

jobs.title: (Senior) IT Key Account Manager w/m/d (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:

Freu Dich auf ein starkes Team

Entdecke Deine Perspektiven als IT Sales-Expert:in

Was das Richtige für unsere Kunden ist? Wir sind überzeugt: Diese Frage beantwortest Du am besten! Ob große Konzernkunden aus verschiedenen Branchen oder globale Unternehmen – Du berätst Deine Ansprechpartner:innen auf Augenhöhe und entscheidest frei und flexibel, welche IT-Lösung die richtige ist. Freiheit hast Du auch bei Deinem Arbeitsmodell. Denn wo und wann Du arbeitest, entscheidest Du – natürlich immer im Sinne Deiner Kunden. Das Know-how, um herausragend zu sein? Erhältst Du von unserer Sales-Community sowie durch interne und externe Trainings. Und wenn’s beim Kunden der technische Deep Dive sein soll, kannst Du Dich auf Deine Kolleg:innen aus Consulting, Solution Design, Deal Support und Partnermanagement zu 100 Prozent verlassen!

Deine Aufgaben

- Du steuerst alle vertrieblichen Aktivitäten zum Kunden! Zusammen mit Deinen Kollegen aus Service Management, Consulting, Vertriebsinnendienst und Fachvertrieb begeisterst Du die Ansprechpartner auf allen Kundenebenen und zu allen IT-Herausforderungen.
- Durch Deinen Ideenreichtum und das Aufspüren neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten gewinnst Du nachhaltiges Vertrauen beim Kunden und wirst als Trusted Advisor geschätzt.
- Du koordinierst fachlich personelle und materielle Ressourcen und trägst die Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung. Dies gilt in umfassenden Projekten in all unseren Technologie- (u.a. Datacenter, Networking, Workplace, Security, IoT, Apps & Data) und Servicebereichen (Technology Services, Professional und Managed Services).
- Auf Basis unseres innovativen und breiten Portfolios rund um Datacenter, Networking, Security und Cloud erschließt Du für Computacenter neue profitable Deals. Damit kannst Du Deine Kunden in die Breite entwickeln und sie gleichzeitig noch erfolgreicher machen.
- Deine Präsenz, Deine Ausdauer und nicht zuletzt Deine Leidenschaft für Vertrieb zeigen sich in Deiner unumstößlichen Kundenorientierung - Customer First!

Dein Profil

- Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertriebsaußendienst und im strategischen Geschäftsausbau mit Fokus auf IT-Lösungs- und Servicevertrieb
- Erfahrungen in der Steuerung von Angebotssituationen und Kundenbeauftragungen
- Begeisterung für die Technologiefelder Client/Server, Datacenter oder Networking und sicherer Umgang mit betriebswirtschaftlichen Kennzahlen und Kalkulationen
- Überzeugende Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch

Wir bieten

- Mobile Working und flexible Arbeitszeiten – Vertrauen ist gut. Punkt.
- Gehalt – Unser Provisions- und Bonusmodell ist eines der attraktivsten Vergütungsmodelle der Branche.
- Weiterentwicklung – Wir investieren in Dich! Ob interne oder externe Trainings, Fach- oder Managementkarriere, Konferenzen, Events, Mentoring oder Coaching.
- Kultur – Das „Du" gilt bei uns über alle Ebenen. Wir sind nahbar – und einfach wir selbst.

Über uns

Computacenter ist ein internationales IT-Unternehmen mit einer 40-jährigen Erfolgsgeschichte. Allein in Deutschland bringen rund 7.000 Menschen die digitale Transformation voran: Sie entwickeln IT-Strategien, implementieren neue Technologien oder managen komplexe Infrastrukturen – für die Mehrheit der DAX-Unternehmen ebenso wie für große öffentliche Auftraggeber.

Als unabhängiger Partner aller führenden IT-Hersteller (wie z. B. Microsoft, Apple, IBM, HP, Cisco, Intel) sind wir in allen relevanten Technologiebereichen unterwegs: von Cyber Security, Cloud und Künstlicher Intelligenz über agile Software-Entwicklung bis hin zu Arbeitsplatzlösungen für die Smart Factory.

Und das Beste an uns? Ganz einfach: Die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten, in ihrer Vielfalt, mit ihrem Potenzial und ihren individuellen Lebensentwürfen.

Klingt gut? Ist auch gut! Jetzt bewerben.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Online-Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie Religion. Bewerbungen von schwerbehinderten Menschen sind bei Computacenter willkommen und werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, AdTech Campaigns - Vendor (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer II (Golang) to join our AdTech tribe. You'll help build our next-generation advertising platform that helps partners – restaurants and local shops – promote their best dishes, attract new customers, and grow their business. If you enjoy solving concrete engineering problems, growing your ownership over real production systems, and learning from a senior, distributed team, this is a great next step – and Berlin is waiting for you.

You'll join the squad owning a critical piece of the AdTech ecosystem: the Campaigns Squad, which powers the creation and management of campaigns across all Delivery Hero brands globally, and the Advertiser Service, the central solution for advertiser data. You will contribute to the scalability, performance, and resilience of these services as part of a squad supporting a global user base.

- Own and deliver well-scoped features end-to-end within the Campaigns and Advertiser services, from design input through to production.
- Write clean, well-tested, maintainable Go code that meets the team's engineering and security standards.
- Contribute to architecture and design discussions for the features you build, with guidance from senior engineers.
- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other squads across the AdTech tribe to ship reliable solutions.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the services you help maintain, escalating and learning as needed.
- Participate actively in code reviews, estimations, and team ceremonies, and keep growing your technical and business understanding.

Qualifications

- 2+ years of professional software development experience, with solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
- Hands-on experience with Go (or strong proficiency in another backend language plus a genuine interest in Go) and a good understanding of service-oriented / microservices patterns.
- Experience with relational (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
- Some exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes, and a willingness to deepen this knowledge.
- A quality-first mindset: you write tests, care about readability, and are comfortable asking for and giving feedback in code reviews.
- Good communication skills and fluent English.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week

- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym Subsidy.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

Gesundung und Heilung für Körper, Geist und Seele im Heilhaus Kassel
„Die Vision des Heilhauses beschreibt einen Ort, an dem die Einheit von Geburt, Leben und Sterben beheimatet ist. Kinder werden geboren, Menschen suchen und erfahren Heilung, Sterbende leben in Würde ihr Leben bis zu Ende.“ (aus der Präambel der Satzung der Heilhaus-Stiftung Ursa Paul)

Der Tagungsbereich des Heilhauses ist verantwortlich für die Reinigung und Pflege der Räume sowie die Beherbergung von Seminar-, Haus- und Kurgästen.
Für unser Team suchen wir ab sofort in Teilzeit eine/einen

Hauswirtschafter*in (m/w/d)

Wir bieten Ihnen:

- Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit Verantwortung
- Ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld
- Einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem Erfahrung und Eigeninitiative geschätzt werden
- JobTicket

Ihre Aufgaben

- Leitung und Organisation unseres Reinigungsteams
- Organisation und Koordination von Auf- und Abbauten bei Veranstaltungen
- Organisation und Vorbereitung der Gästezimmer
- Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Ablaufs im hauswirtschaftlichen Bereich

Wir wünschen uns:

- Erfahrung im Bereich Hauswirtschaft oder in einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit
- Organisationstalent und eine selbstständige, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
- Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team
- Verantwortungsbewusstsein und einen Blick für Ordnung und Sauberkeit

Sie haben Erfahrung in der Hauswirtschaft und organisieren gerne? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Das Heilhaus Kassel folgt den Grundsätzen der Chancengleichheit, wir schätzen Vielfalt. Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns, Sie kennen zu lernen!
Informationen zum Heilhaus finden Sie unter www.heilhaus.org.

Heilhaus Kassel gemeinnützige GmbH, Jutta von Westernhagen, Brandaustr. 10, 34127 Kassel, bewerbung.gf@heilhaus.org

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer “SURU Connect” (f/m/d) (Bachelor Professional - IT (Softwareentwicklung))
jobs.description:
Senior Cloud Developer “SURU Connect” (f/m/d)

Are you ready to kickstart your career and take on a versatile role right from the start? To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Junior Accounting Specialist (m/f/d) at the earliest possible opportunity.

As a Senior Cloud Developer, you will design, build, and operate cloud-native applications that are core toSURU Connect and SURU SignalHub.Working across the full solution lifecycle, you will turn customer and business needs into scalable, secure, andreliable digital products. Using C#, modern .NET, Blazor and AWS, you will take technical ownership whilehelping shape architecture, engineering practices, and the future direction of SURU´s connected water andIoT platforms.

What You´ll Do:

- Design, develop, test, and applications for SURU Connect and SURU SignalHub, including APIs,background services, data-processing pipelines, and modern** Blazor **web applications
- Design reliable event-driven and distributed solutions on AWS using appropriate managed services,messaging, databases, and Infrastructure as Code. Integrate IoT devices, connectivity providers, externalplatforms, and customer systems, selecting the technologies andarchitectural patterns that best fit each usecase rather than being tied to a fixed stack
- Work closely with product, business, customers, and external partners to identify valuable use cases andtranslate them into effective technical solutions. Own solutions from initial concept and architecture throughimplementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operation
- Continuously improve reliability, scalability, security, observability, performance, and delivery automation.Contribute to architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, and knowledge sharing, while usingAI-assisted development tools and AI agents extensively for implementation, testing, debugging,documentation, quality assurance, and automatedsoftware delivery

What You´ll Bring:

Wir suchen für unsere Einrichtung Betreutes Einzelwohnen (BEW) ab 01.10.2026

eine soz. päd. Fachkraft (Dipl. Sozialpäd., Soziale Arbeit Bachelor, Dipl. Päd.) m/w/d

mit 37,5 Wochenstunden (7,5 Wochenstunden befristet als Elternzeitvertretung)

Über uns: Die Gesellschaft für Soziale Arbeit. München ist ein Sozialunternehmen, das Kinder, Jugendliche, junge Erwachsene und Familien in und mit unterschiedlichsten Lebensphasen, Themen**,** Problematiken und Gefährdungspotentialen betreut und begleitet.

Wir sind von der DGSF mit dem Siegel „systemisch-familienorientiert arbeitende Einrichtung“ zertifiziert und arbeiten in allen Arbeitsbereichen mit einer systemischen Haltung und nutzen systemische Methoden in der Fallarbeit und -reflexion.

Die Abteilung Betreutes Einzelwohnen BEW unterstützt jungen Erwachsenen mit psychischen Beeinträchtigungen in ihrer individuellen Teilhabe am Leben. Wir betrachten psychische Erkrankungen nicht als Versagen des Einzelnen, sondern als eine logische Reaktion auf die hohen und widersprüchlichen Anforderungen unserer Gesellschaft. Unser vorrangiges Ziel besteht darin, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, ein möglichst selbstbestimmtes Leben zu führen und die Herausforderungen des Alltags zu bewältigen. Die ambulante Betreuung erfolgt entweder in den Appartements unseres Trägers oder in den eigenen Wohnungen der Klient:innen, stets im Rahmen unseres bewährten Bezugspersonensystems.

Das Team: Was uns besonders auszeichnet, ist unser humorvolles und lebendiges Team, das sich kontinuierlich fachlich weiterentwickelt. Mit viel Spaß und Einsatz setzen wir uns gemeinsam für das Wohl unserer Klientel ein. Ein zentraler Aspekt unserer Arbeit ist der fachliche Austausch innerhalb unseres interdisziplinären Teams. Regelmäßige Fallbesprechungen, enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem psychologischen Fachdienst und Reflexionsrunden mit unserer Klientel sind für uns selbstverständlich. Diese Praxis ermöglicht es uns, Qualitätsstandards zu sichern, unsere Professionalität zu erhöhen und uns in schwierigen Situationen gegenseitig zu entlasten.

Unsere wertschätzende Grundhaltung ist dabei die Basis unserer täglichen Arbeit. Eigenverantwortliches Handeln und die Bereitschaft, flexibel auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Klient:innen einzugehen, sind für uns von besonderer Bedeutung. Wir schätzen die Vielfalt der Menschen, mit denen wir arbeiten, und sind stolz darauf, einen Raum zu schaffen, in dem sich jede Persönlichkeit entfalten kann.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Gestaltung des Hilfeprozesses nach dem Gesamtplanverfahren (Eingliederungshilfe nach dem SGB IX);
- Hilfeplanerstellung und dessen Umsetzung mit elektronischer Dokumentation und Sicherstellung von organisatorischen und administrativen Abläufen;
- Sozialpädagogische Betreuung, Begleitung und Beratung junger Erwachsener in den Bereichen Beziehungsgestaltung, Selbstversorgung und Wohnen, beruflicher Orientierung und Integration, Tages- und Freizeitgestaltung, sowie Umgang mit der psychischen Beeinträchtigung und Entwicklung von Coping-Strategien;
- Klientelbezogene Kooperationspflege mit Angehörigen, gesetzlichen Vertretern, Ärzten, Ämtern, Einrichtungen und Diensten
- Krisenintervention
- Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen und Supervision

Unsere Standards

- Bezahlung analog TVöD VKA SuE EG 12
- Münchenzulage, SuE-Zulage
- Fahrtkostenzuschuss DeutschlandticketJob
- Arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge BVK/ZVK
- Fortbildungsmaßnahmen, regelmäßige Supervisionen
- Möglichkeit zur flexiblen Stellengestaltung in zwei oder mehr Abteilungen innerhalb der GfSA München.
- Gute Aufstiegs- und Karrierechancen
- Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und familienbewusste Unternehmenskultur zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und Freizeit
- E-Gym Wellpass
- flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Zeitwertkonten/Sabbatical
- Urlaubsanspruch nach TVöD VKA West zzgl. 2 arbeitsfreie Tage (24.12.+31.12.)
- bis zu 2 Regenerationstage
- Mitarbeiter:innen-Events
- persönliche Benefits durch die Mitgliedschaft im Paritätischen Wohlfahrtsverband
- Möglichkeit zum flexiblen und mobilen Arbeiten z.B. durch Dienstsmartphones und Laptops

Ihre Ressourcen

- Eine wertschätzende und partizipatorische Haltung
- eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten im Rahmen der konzeptionellen und rechtlichen Vorgaben
- Kommunikations-, Kooperations- und Konfliktfähigkeit
- Fähigkeit zur Selbstreflexion und Selbstmanagement
- Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen fachlichen Weiterentwicklung
- Praktische Handlungskompetenz
- Einfühlungsvermögen für Diversität
- Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeitgestaltung
- idealerweise Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Eingliederungshilfe und/oder psychischer Erkrankungen

Sie haben Interesse sich zu engagieren? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung per Mail bis 07.09..2026 an:

Gesellschaft für Soziale Arbeit. München

Abteilung Betreutes Einzelwohnen BEW

Frau Anne Thoms

bewerbung@gfsa-muenchen.de (bewerbung@gfsa-muenchen.de)

Wir fördern die Chancengleichheit aller Klient:innen und Beschäftigten und bekennen uns zur freiheitlich-demokratischen Grundordnung. Bewerber:innen sollten unsere Werte teilen. In unseren Einrichtungen setzen wir uns für ein respektvolles, vielfältiges und demokratisches Miteinander ein; daher können wir Bewerber:innen, die sich aktiv in rechtsextremen Gruppen oder Parteien engagieren und/oder diese Werte teilen, nicht berücksichtigen.

Wir setzen uns für den Schutz von Kindern und Jugendlichen vor Gewalt und sexuellem Missbrauch ein und freuen uns daher besonders über Bewerber*innen, die diesen Themenkomplex durch Ihr Handeln in der Einrichtung aktiv stärken.
