jobs.title: Chief of Staff, CRO
Data Quality Officer (M/F)
jobs.description:
BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a highly motivated, rigorous, and detail-oriented Data Quality Officer to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for our Data Quality Framework, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of our data across systems and processes. This role is critical in supporting enhancing our data-driven decision-making capabilities.

Your next challenge:

• Collaborate with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and IT teams to ensure continuous improvement of data quality standards.
• Develop AI-powered agents to generate, maintain, and optimize Data Quality rules.
• Automate Data Quality monitoring, issue detection, root cause analysis, and remediation workflows.
• Integrate Data Quality processes with Data Governance and Metadata Management platforms.
• Leverage Generative AI and Microsoft Copilot technologies to increase productivity and automate repetitive activities.
• Define KPIs and dashboards to measure Data Quality performance and automation benefits.
• Support the data stewards in the design of Data Quality Rules
• Build data quality dashboards, monitor and report on data quality metrics.
• Monitor the Data Quality Register and follow up on remediation plans.
• Implement data quality rules.
• Design and implement data quality standards, policies, and procedures.
• Maintain documentation of data quality processes and procedures.
• Conduct regular data quality assessments and audits to ensure compliance with data governance policies.
• Provide training and support to staff on data quality best practices and tools.
• Stay up-to-date with industry best practices and emerging trends in data quality management.

Your skills:

• Master's degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance or a related field.
• Proven experience in data quality management, data governance, or a similar role within the banking or financial services industry.
• Technical knowledge (SQL or Python).
• Proactive, innovation-oriented mindset.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Experience with workflow automation platforms and low-code solutions.
• Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI concepts.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Inbound Strategy, Long Term Network Planning (m/f)
jobs.description:
Sr. Program Manager, Inbound Strategy, Long Term Network Planning
Job ID: 10498640 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Amazon's Inbound Long Term Planning team owns the topology framework that decides what the EU inbound network looks like in 2–3 years: which node types we build, where we place them, how they interact, and what inventory configuration they unlock. This role owns a critical slice of that framework - taking speed ambitions and placement targets and working backwards into the physical network design across 1DCs, RDCs, and IXDs that makes them achievable. It's the kind of problem where getting the answer right saves hundreds of millions of dollars; getting it wrong means we either over-invest or structurally cap our speed ceiling for years.

You'll work at the intersection of network topology, inventory science, and capital allocation - partnering deeply with Finance, IIPO, AIM, and business teams to determine the optimal long-term node configuration that delivers placement targets per outbound node type and selection cohort. This is a single-threaded role with high ambiguity and regular exposure to senior leadership across SCOT, Operations, and Finance.

Key Job Responsibilities

- Own the long-term inbound topology framework - determine the optimal combination of node types, locations, and capacities that achieves placement targets at minimum total cost.

- Define network configuration per selection cohort - decide velocity demarcations between node types, regional zoning, and upstream storage share. Know when the model breaks and why.
- Build the multi-year inbound build plan - sequence node launches, size them against volume trajectories, and own the placement and inventory commitments that justify the investment.
- Resolve structural trade-offs that don't have clean owners. Frame options, quantify impact, and drive decisions when priorities across teams or geographies conflict.
- Align senior leadership to  single answer. Write the strategy documents that SCOT, Finance, IIPO, and Operations commit to. When priorities diverge, you reconcile.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

jobs.title: Group General Counsel - International Company (m/f)
jobs.description:
ADEM DECLARATION OF VACANT POSITION AND JOB DESCRIPTION
General Counsel YIO S.à r.l., Luxembourg

JOB DESCRIPTION

Group General Counsel

Employer: YIO S.à r.l., Luxembourg.

Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, with dotted reporting line to the Board.
Contract: permanent, full-time (40 hours per week). Location: Luxembourg, hybrid, with regular international
travel.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support
• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.
2. Corporate, M&A and governance
• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.
3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation
• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.
4. High risk industry, trust and safety, and content compliance
• Advise on the legal and regulatory framework applicable to adult oriented and creator monetization platforms, including age assurance and identity verification, performer consent and record keeping obligations, nonconsensual intimate image takedown, CSAM prevention and reporting, and content moderation and appeals.
• Design and maintain creator terms, model releases, content licences, revenue share arrangements and agency and management arrangements.
• Advise on advertising, affiliate and performance marketing arrangements, influencer marketing rules and consumer protection requirements in the EU, the UK and the US.
• Manage intellectual property, including trademarks, copyright enforcement and anti-piracy programmes.
5. Payments, financial crime and sanctions
• Own the legal side of the group's payments stack, including acquirer and payment service provider agreements, alternative payment methods, payout and creator disbursement arrangements and merchant of record structures.
• Advise on card scheme rules as they apply to high risk and adult merchant categories, including high brand risk and integrity risk registration programmes, prohibited content rules, chargeback thresholds and remediation plans.
• Advise on PSD2 and strong customer authentication, electronic money and payment institution perimeter questions, and the implications of the EU instant payments and payment services reform.
• Own the group's KYC, AML, CTF and sanctions framework, including creator onboarding, transaction monitoring, and screening against EU, UK, US OFAC and other relevant measures. 6. Commercial and employment
• Negotiate the group's material commercial agreements, including technology, content, distribution, partnership and vendor agreements.
• Support the people function on employment law across multiple jurisdictions, including contracts, contractor classification, incentive schemes and internal investigations.

3 Required profile

The following are requirements (must-haves):
• Law degree from an EU or EEA or UK university.
• Admission in good standing to the bar of an EU or EEA Member State or UK.
• A minimum of 20 years of PQE legal experience, of which at least 10 years in a senior in house legal leadership role (General Counsel, Head of Legal or equivalent).
• Demonstrable experience of building and leading an international in house legal team across diverse jurisdictions.
• A track record of leading cross border M&A transactions in the US, UK and/or EU jurisdictions.
• Corporate governance experience in complex international structures.
• Recognised privacy certification (IAPP CIPP/E or equivalent) and hands on ownership of a GDPR compliance programme.
• Direct working knowledge of the EU/UK digital regulatory framework, including DSA, DMA, OSA, the AI Act, AVMS.
• Substantive experience in high risk regulated industries, and specifically in adult entertainment or creator platform compliance.
• Substantive experience of payment processing and billing for high-risk merchant categories.
• Experience in entertainment and media.
• Tax, KYC/AML and sanctions experience in a regulated or high risk environment.
• Experience advising founders, C level executives and Boards in a venture backed, high growth environment.
• English at level C (native/bilingual/proficient user).

The following are advantages (nice to haves):
• Postgraduate business qualification (MBA or equivalent).
• Formal training or certification in AI
• Recognised corporate governance certification (e.g. ILA CGO).
• Qualification or formal training in international taxation and in corporate compliance.
• Experience of a Luxembourg holding structure and of Luxembourg corporate and employment law.
• Additional languages, in particular Spanish, French, Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish.
• Prior experience in a matrix organisation or in the country or regional unit of a multinational group.

4 Personal attributes

• Commercial and pragmatic. Comfortable taking a risk-based position and defending it to the Board.
• Comfortable operating hands on in a lean team while also delegating and developing others.
• Able to work across cultures and time zones, and to hold credibility with founders, investors, regulators and counterparties.
• Willing to work in a business whose content categories include adult material.

5 Terms

• Contract: permanent (contrat à durée indéterminée), governed by Luxembourg law.
• Working time: full time, 40 hours per week, flexible arrangement.
• Place of work: [LuxCo address], Luxembourg, with hybrid working and regular travel, principally to London.
• Remuneration: gross annual salary between EUR 150,000 and EU [...]

jobs.title: Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Specialist (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


About our client

Our client is a renowned family-owned company operating in Luxembourg and currently undergoing an exciting phase of growth and transformation.
As part of its continued growth and professionalization, the company is strengthening its Human Resources function and is looking for an experienced Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Specialist to join the team.


Position Summary

Reporting to the People, Organisation and HR Operations Director, you will take ownership of payroll administration, compensation & benefits coordination, HR administration and time management processes.
You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while contributing to the modernization and digitalization of HR processes.
Beyond daily payroll and rewards operations, you will own a continuous payroll, compensation & benefits and HR operations development agenda, leading transformation initiatives that modernize practices, streamline processes and strengthen systems in line with the company's growth objectives.


Key Responsibilities:


Payroll Administration

• Coordinate and prepare all payroll-related information for the external payroll provider.
• Ensure the accuracy of payroll inputs and employee data.
• Manage payroll-related changes, including salary reviews, promotions, departures and retirements.
• Coordinate variable compensation elements, commissions and overtime information.
• Manage payroll-related communication regarding absences, sick leave and employee lifecycle events.
• Perform payroll controls and reconciliations to ensure data accuracy.


Compensation & Benefits

• Administer employee benefits programs.
• Support salary review and compensation benchmarking exercises.
• Participate in the development of compensation and benefits policies.
• Coordinate bonus and incentive programs.
• Monitor market trends and recommend improvements to reward structures.


HR Administration

• Prepare employment contracts and contractual amendments.
• Manage employee files and HR documentation.
• Coordinate onboarding and offboarding administration.
• Ensure proper documentation and compliance with internal procedures.
• Maintain accurate employee records.


Time Management

• Manage and maintain employee data within the time management system.
• Administer absences, vacations, overtime and working-time records.
• Ensure accurate integration between time management and payroll processes.
• Support managers and employees regarding working-time matters.


Process Improvement, Projects & HR Systems

• Take ownership of a payroll, compensation & benefits and HR operations improvement roadmap, managing a pipeline of projects focused on the modernization and digitalization of HR processes.
• Identify and drive opportunities for automation, process optimization and data-quality improvements across payroll, time management and rewards processes.
• Lead or actively support HRIS and systems enhancement projects related to payroll, time management and compensation & benefits.
• Develop and improve HR reporting capabilities, ensuring reliable people and rewards data to support decision-making.
• Champion continuous improvement initiatives across the HR function, collaborating with stakeholders to enhance organizational effectiveness.


Profile:

Education & Experience

• Strong educational background, preferably a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field.
• At least 5 years of experience in payroll, compensation & benefits and/or HR administration.
• Experience working with an external payroll provider is highly desirable.
• Previous experience within the Luxembourg payroll environment is essential.


Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of payroll administration processes.
• Knowledge of compensation and benefits practices.
• Attention to detail and data accuracy.
• Good understanding of HR administration and employment lifecycle processes.
• Experience with time management systems.
• Excel and reporting skills.


Languages

• Fluency in French and/or German.
• A professional level of English is required.


Personal Attributes

• Highly organized, structured and reliable.
• Strong analytical mindset.
• Service-oriented approach.
• Continuous improvement mindset.
• Comfortable working in a changing environment.


What they Offer

• Opportunity to play a central role in HR transformation and modernization beyond traditional payroll administration.
• High visibility within the organization.
• Broad responsibilities and autonomy.
• Long-term career development opportunities.
• Collaborative and entrepreneurial environment.
• Modernization and project exposure beyond traditional payroll administration.
• Flexible working hours
• 1 day of working from home (34 days maximum for border employees).

jobs.title: Director of Compensation Strategy
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE SUMMARY

Replit is the world's most widely used AI coding platform, and as we scale, we're rebuilding how compensation works internally from the ground up. This role owns that. You'll go beyond traditional comp management to architect the systems, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled workflows that make fast, consistent, and high-quality compensation decisions possible at scale. 

You will serve as the architect of our compensation engine: translating compensation philosophy into scalable systems, and utilizing AI to improve speed, accuracy, and transparency. 

You will partner closely with People Business Partners, Recruiting, Finance, People Operations, and the Data team to embed compensation directly into company workflows, eliminating manual processes and reducing reliance on comp as a service layer.

You will shape how we attract, reward, and retain top talent, while building infrastructure that scales with the business.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Compensation Strategy

 - Evolve our compensation philosophy across cash and equity; design and maintain salary bands, leveling frameworks, and equity structures

 - Ensure market competitiveness while partnering with Finance on cost and workforce planning

 - Operate compensation planning cycles and generate first-pass recommendations for comp decisions

 - Build dashboards and analytical frameworks covering market competitiveness, internal equity, retention risk, and workforce cost



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in compensation, total rewards, or related analytical roles, ideally at a high-growth tech company

 - Deep expertise in salary bands, equity design, and market benchmarking (broad-based, sales, and executive)

 - Strong systems thinker who can translate policy into scalable workflows and decision logic

 - Product mindset - you think in terms of users, workflows, and iteration

 - High ownership; willing to operate hands-on


Nice to have

AI-Native Workflows

 - Design and implement AI-enabled workflows for offers, merit, promotions, and market adjustments

 - Build human-in-the-loop validation frameworks to audit AI-generated recommendations for bias, accuracy, and logic
   
   
   Tools: Pave, Radford, Rippling, Lattice, Ashby, Carta, Google Sheets, internal AI/automation tooling

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

Galvenie pienākumi:

  • Veikt dažādus palīgdarbus būvlaukumā atbilstoši brigadiera vai darbu vadītāja norādījumiem.

  • Palīdzēt materiālu iekraušanā/izkraušanā, tostarp objekta teritorijas uzkopšanā.

  • Piedalīties būvmateriālu un instrumentu iekraušanā, izkraušanā, pārvietošanā un sakārtošanā objektā.

  • Sniedz palīdzību speciālistiem (elektriķiem, meistariem u.c.) dažādu darbu veikšanā.

  • Veikt vienkāršus demontāžas darbus.

  • Palīdzēt materiālu sagatavošanāi.

  • Uzturēt kārtību būvlaukumā:  sakopt darba vietas, nodrošināt materiālu pareizu uzglabāšanu.

  • Rūpēties par instrumentu un tehnikas pamataprūpi – tīrīšanu, sakārtošanu un nodošanu atpakaļ noliktavā.

  • Veikt nelielus, vienkāršus remonta darbus pēc norādījumiem.

  • Sekot būvniecības drošības noteikumiem, lietot aizsarglīdzekļus, ievērot darba disciplīnu un instrukcijas.

Papildu pienākumi (ja nepieciešams):

  • Zemes darbi: rakšana, līdzināšana, tranšeju palīdzīga sagatavošana.

  • Palīdzība sastatņu montāžā un demontāžā pieredzējušu darbinieku uzraudzībā.

  • Palīdzības darbi iekšējās apdares procesos: špaktelēšanai, krāsošanai, materiālu sagatavošanai.

jobs.title: Administraator
jobs.description:
Vastuvõtu administraator

Tööülesanded: Administraatori tööülesannete alla kuulub eelkõige külalistega ladus suhtlemine ja abivalmis hoiak. Tuleb külalisi sisse- kui ka välja registreerida, hoida silm peal e-mailidel ning aidata kliente ka telefoni teel.
Ootame kandidaadilt täpsust maksete ja broneeringusüsteemide haldamisel ning oskust olla vahelüliks erinevate osakondade vahel. Loodame leida vastutustundlikku ja rõõmsameelset inimest, kes oskaks ennast vabalt väljendada nii eesti kui ka inglise keeles. Suhtlustasemel vene keel ja muud võõrkeeled tulevad kasuks.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume graafiku alusel tööd ajavahemikul 7:00 - 23:00. Sõltuvalt hooajast ning vajadustest 8-10 tunnised vahetused, kas hommikul alates 7:00 või 12:30. Valmis tuleb olla ka pühadel ja nädalavahetustel töötamiseks.
Toimib igakuine motiveeriv boonussüsteem kus töötasu sõltub tööülesannete korrektsest täitmisest, meeskonnatööst ning klientide tagasisidest. Huvitav ja vaheldusrikas töö, sõbraliku ning üksteist toetava kollektiiviga, kellega tehakse koos ka ühisüritusi. Kontor asub vanalinnas. Võimalus töötada osalise tööajaga.

Muud nõuded: Sobivalt kandidaadilt ootame:
Valmisolekut meeskonnatööks; Head eesti ja inglise keele oskust, suhtlustasemel vene keelt; Positiivset ja avatud suhtlemist; Valmisolek mõnel korral nädalas olema peale tööpäeva telefoni valves; Valmisolekut töötamiseks päevasel ajal graafiku alusel, vahetustega (kaasaarvatud pühad ja nädalavahetused); Kohusetundlikkust, täpsusust.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Server
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.
- Detail-oriented and proactive, and flexible ensuring accuracy in orders, presentation standards, and anticipating customer needs. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - Health-conscious and committed to upholding food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols. - Proficiency in coffee preparation (espresso machines) and knowledge of basic alcoholic drink recipes and responsible service practices (preferred). - Experience in operating POS systems, handling payments, and managing accurate transactions efficiently (preferred). - A valid health certificate is required for food handling. - Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays or supplies for extended periods. - Legal eligibility to meet age requirements for serving alcohol. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts:
Part time (0.25 - 0.75)

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.

 - Fluent in English and French






NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.title: Swedish speaking sales agents to Barcelona!
jobs.description:
Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Vi är en av Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer. Och svenska kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

jobs.title: Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) Online game presenter Malta!
jobs.description:
Do you want to get away from the dark winter in Sweden or cold part of europe? Here is your chance!!

Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?

Are you passionate about being on camera?

Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

We offer you:

    Relocation package (flight and accommodation for the first 20 nights - if applicable)
    Monthly bonuses; based on performance, team player attitude and loyalty
    Up to 3 weeks of training in our Academy
    Free Gym Membership
    Workshops in things like; make-up, healthy living, presentation skills and industry knowledge
    Night shift taxi drop off service

Qualifications

To apply you need to be:

    Fluent in Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish), working knowledge of English is essential
    Service-minded with good communications skills
    A fast-learner
    A flexible team player
    Professional, mature and with a natural ability to follow work rules
    An entertainer at heart
    Excellent customer service skills
    Manage Player expectations and behavior
    Minimum 18 years old

Please note that you need to have valid travel documents and that we will ask you to provide a valid Police Conduct Certificate and a written statement from your last employer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Developer Platform
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Developer Platform https://www.notion.com/product/dev engineer, you will directly contribute to the foundational pieces that make Notion extensible and connected. You will build tools, APIs, and platform experiences that help customers connect Notion to the world — bringing their apps, data, and workflows into one workspace. Your work will make it easier for developers, admins, and builders to create reliable integrations and automations on top of Notion.


You will be a key player in building the robust technical foundation that allows Notion to achieve the connected workspace vision. Your work will include both internal platform contributions that accelerate other Notion engineering teams and end-user-facing functionality that enables toolmaking ubiquity. You will be presented with challenging technical problems, as Notion’s product needs are complex. You’ll play a key role in identifying and executing against technical investments that ensure the long-term quality, reliability, and performance of Notion’s platform as we scale.


This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You’ll work with a team of engineers and cross-functional partners across product, design, data science, and user research to define a product strategy and drive execution through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance.

 - You’ll evolve Developer Platform capabilities across APIs, MCP tools, and integration infrastructure that help customers automate workflows, customize Notion, and connect Notion to the tools and data they use every day.

 - You’ll contribute to the overall performance, reliability, and robustness of the Notion product, ensuring it scales elegantly across many dimensions.

 - You’ll partner with engineering leaders to identify and execute against high-leverage technical investments that ensure the long-term flexibility and sustainability of our core systems.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 7+ years of experience shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end

 - Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend

 - Strong product instincts: you can take a vague problem, propose a solid technical approach, and know when to cut scope

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building developer tools like APIs and SDKs

 - Experience driving teams toward shared goals and balancing business priorities with individuals’ strengths, areas of interest, and career development goals

 - Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $213,000 - $320,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Project Engineer – Portuguese-speaking | Industrial Projects
jobs.description:
About the role

This is a hands-on project role where you will coordinate activities, follow up on purchases and deliveries, communicate with customers and suppliers, and make sure agreed actions progress according to schedule.

The assignment is initially six months, and we hope you can start as soon as possible.

Work tasks

You will work closely with an experienced international project organization and support a Project Manager responsible for several customer projects. The team has recently grown, creating a need for additional project engineering capacity.

A significant part of the role involves projects in Portuguese-speaking markets in South America, which makes fluent Portuguese essential. You will communicate directly with customers and help translate their needs into concrete actions within the project organization.

The projects are related primarily to large industrial engines, engine components and associated technical services. You do not need to be an engine specialist when you join, but you should be comfortable working with technical equipment and industrial projects.

The role combines project coordination, customer communication, procurement and technical understanding. Success requires an organised and proactive approach: when something needs to happen, you take ownership of following it through.

Your responsibilities may include:
- Coordinating international customer and delivery projects
- Communicating with Portuguese-speaking customers in South America
- Following project schedules, open actions and deliveries
- Ensuring agreed tasks progress and proactively following up with stakeholders
- Creating and following purchase orders and procurement activities
- Working with ERP systems, particularly SAP
- Coordinating suppliers and external service providers
- Supporting sourcing and procurement of services such as machining, lifting and specialist field services
- Investigating delivery issues and other project deviations
- Collaborating with Project Managers, procurement, logistics, technical experts, suppliers and customers
- Supporting customer meetings and project-related travel to South America

We are looking for

For this position, you must have:
- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering
- Professional fluency in Portuguese
- Professional working proficiency in English
- Previous experience in project work where you have independently coordinated activities, followed schedules and ensured actions are completed
- Experience working with purchasing, purchase orders, deliveries or similar ERP-based processes
- Ability to understand technical equipment and communicate effectively in an industrial environment
- Willingness and ability to travel to South America when required
- Experience with SAP
- A valid driving licence

You do not need to speak Finnish.

We consider it a strong advantage if you have experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Marine, maritime or shipbuilding industry
- Engine technology or powertrain systems
- Industrial machinery or equipment
- Technical service or maintenance projects
- Procurement and supplier coordination
- Automation
- Customer-facing technical project roles

Your previous job title could for example be Project Engineer, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Delivery Engineer, Service Engineer, Technical Project Engineer or Procurement Engineer. More important than the title is that you understand how technical projects work and are comfortable taking responsibility for keeping them on track.

As a person, we believe you are
- Proactive and comfortable taking ownership
- Organised and able to manage several ongoing topics simultaneously
- Confident communicating directly with customers
- Persistent in following up and getting things completed
- Comfortable working across different countries, cultures and functions
- Practical and solution-oriented when plans change

Practical information
- Salary: based on your background and experience about 3500 - 4500 € / month
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 6 months
- Working hours: Full-time
- Location: Flexible within Finland. The role can be performed largely remotely, although occasional presence in Turku is required.
- Travel: The position includes occasional international business travel, primarly to South America.
- Languages: Portuguese and English
- Employment: Fixed-term employment through Academic Work, working as a consultant in our client organisation

About the client

Our client is a globally operating technology company providing advanced solutions and services for demanding marine and industrial environments. Its international project organisation works with customers around the world on large-scale technical equipment, lifecycle services and complex delivery projects.

You will join an experienced international organisation where you will work with technically interesting projects and gain exposure to global customers, suppliers and engineering professionals.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Office Responsible -- Join Our International Team in Norway

We are currently seeking a dedicated and motivated Office Responsible to join our dynamic team. This is a key role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys balancing structure, communication, and customer service. If you are detail-oriented, solution-driven, and looking to contribute to a growing company in the travel and outdoor industry, we would be pleased to hear from you.

As the Office Responsible, you will be the first point of contact for many of our customers and a central figure in our day-to-day operations. You will handle booking and pre-booking coordination, assist with post-rental customer service, and manage internal support functions such as invoicing and payment allocations.

You will also provide critical backup to our rental agent team when needed, offering variety and ensuring smooth operations across departments. This position requires strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to stay focused when working with complex information.

We are looking for a candidate who brings prior experience in coordination work or a similar office-based role, and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a structured and organized manner.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide customer support before, during, and after the booking process through email, phone, and online chat

  • Manage booking entries and updates within our booking system

  • Handle deposit processing, damage claims, and customer inquiries post-rental

  • Allocate ferry tickets, tolls, and parking fees to the correct bookings

  • Process invoices, purchase orders, and general company paperwork

  • Support internal accounting by preparing accurate Excel spreadsheets

  • Assist the rental team with operational tasks during busy periods

  • Suggest and support improvements to office workflows and processes


Who We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience in coordination, administration, or a similar office-based role

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (Norwegian is not required)

  • Excellent focus and attention to detail, especially when working with data and allocations

  • Solid working knowledge of Excel and basic accounting practices

  • A problem-solver with a service-oriented mindset

  • Positive, proactive, and eager to take initiative

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • Open to supporting and collaborating with a diverse, international group


Our Work Environment

You will be joining a young and international team based in Norway, made up of outdoor-minded individuals from around the world. Our company language is English, and our work culture values openness, collaboration, and initiative. While the position is office-based, you will be part of a business that supports adventurous travel experiences across the country.

Why Join Us

This is an excellent opportunity to take on a varied and responsible role within a growing company. You will work closely with management and other departments, contribute directly to customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, and be encouraged to bring your ideas to the table.

We offer a supportive and flexible work environment, where professional development is valued, and where your role can evolve as the company grows.

jobs.title: Produktionsmedarbejder søges til vores montage afdeling
jobs.description:
Energy Cool søger en stærk og initiativrig medarbejder med en alsidig tilgang til varierede opgaver til vores montageafdeling i Fredericia.

Vi fremstiller lavenergi-køleløsninger og teknikhuse til telebranchen, hvor vi primært arbejder med montage af tyndplademetal, styringer, ledninger og andre lignende materialer.

Din profil

Den ideelle kandidat har gå-på-mod og lyst til at lære nye opgaver. Du kan håndtere forskellige typer montagearbejde med fokus på at levere et kvalitetsprodukt – uanset om der er tale om finmotorisk eller mere groft arbejde. Har du hænderne skruet rigtigt på, er det et ekstra plus.

Du har ikke nødvendigvis en relevant uddannelse, men din praktiske erfaring gør, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt – også med opgaver, der til tider kan være rutineprægede og monotone.

Du trives med at være en del af et mindre team, hvor teamwork er i højsædet. Du har øje for detaljen og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde. Samtidig er du fleksibel og omstillingsparat i forhold til arbejdsopgaver og møder hverdagen med en positiv tilgang.

Kort sagt søger vi en medarbejder med sans for kvalitet og effektivitet – krydret med en god portion humor.

Det får du

Dit primære område vil være at udføre montageopgaver og bidrage til at sikre den løbende drift på tværs af produktionen. Du vil fungere som en alsidig medarbejder, der er klar til at tage fat, hvor der er behov, og som gerne går det ekstra skridt for sine kolleger.

Vi tilbyder gode kolleger med en bred vifte af kompetencer samt flextid mandag til fredag inden for tidsrummet kl. 06.30–16.00.

Hos Energy Cool bliver du en del af en brugerdreven, innovativ og visionær virksomhed. Vi har en stærk kultur præget af åbenhed, ærlighed og sammenhold – og der er plads til forskellighed.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk hverdag med mulighed for faglig udvikling og plads til professionelle ambitioner.

Om Energy Cool

Virksomheden med de grønne visioner.

Vi producerer energibesparende køleløsninger til server- og teknikrum. Vores løsninger hjælper kunder med at reducere deres energiforbrug og samtidig mindske deres miljøpåvirkning.

Vi udvikler løsninger med fokus på energieffektivitet, driftssikkerhed og de eksisterende og fremtidige krav til miljø og støjbegrænsning. Det gør vi i tæt samarbejde med vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi arbejder konstant på at udvikle endnu bedre løsninger – fra enkeltkomponenter og delsystemer til komplette løsninger. På den måde udfordrer vi eksisterende teknologier og sætter nye standarder for energioptimering.

Interesseret?

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til vores værkfører Nikki Hedemand på nh@energy-cool.com.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

jobs.title: Teknisk sparringspartner til viceværterne og kunderne
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din tekniske ekspertise i ejendomsdrift til at levere professionel rådgivning til et selvkørende hold af viceværter i hele Jylland?

Vores viceværter er hamrende dygtige til at passe vores kunders ejendomme og i takt med at vi vokser, er vi klar til at lægge et teknisk lag mere på.

Det er her, du kommer ind i billedet.

Ikke som leder, men som teknisk sparringspartner, der forstår viceværternes dagligdag og som kan oversætte tekniske dokumenter til håndterbare procedurer.

HVILKE OPGAVER KAN DU SE FREM TIL?

Vi har brug for din ekspertise til at løse tekniske opgaver og hjælpe viceværterne med spørgsmål i hverdagen. Det kan blandt andet handle om:

-    Indstilling af ventilationsanlæg

-    Fejlsøgning og justering af gulvvarmeanlæg

-    Udarbejdelse af DKV-planer

-    Gennemgang og opstart af nye ejendomme

-    Håndtering og opfølgning på garantisager og mangler overfor entreprenører

-    Håndtering af forsikringssager

Du er på forkant med de tekniske aspekter, der sikrer god drift af vores kunders ejendomme. Du bliver samtidig højre hånd for vores team af viceværter, så de altid har en teknisk sparringspartner lige ved hånden.

Det er en alsidig rolle med stor frihed og stort ansvar – men uden store armbevægelser. Hos os er alle en vigtig del af holdet.

Da rollen er ny, er vi klar på at tilpasse den ud fra din faglighed og dine erfaringer. Fortæl os hvordan du ser, at rolle kan passe til dig og hvad du bringer i spil af teknisk viden.

 

HVORFOR ER DET NETOP DIG, VI LEDER EFTER?

Fordi du glæder dig til en hverdag, hvor du finder løsninger sammen med kolleger, kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Fordi du trives i en virksomhed, hvor vi gør os umage og hjælper hinden med at skabe endnu bedre løsninger.

For at kunne varetage rollen er det et krav, at du har en håndværksmæssig eller byggeteknisk baggrund.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

-    Har erfaring med ejendomsdrift eller facility management

-    Skaber overblik og følger op på igangværende sager

-    Skaber tillid blandt kolleger og kunder ved at være serviceminded og troværdig

-    Er fortrolig med almindelige IT-systemer og Office 365

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvilken titel du har i dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, skabe struktur og være med til at udvikle vores forretning.

 

HVEM ER VI?

Vi er Dalbøges Ejendomsservice og vi leverer professionel ejendomsservice til udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og erhvervskunder.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, en del af PHM Group og har flere Gazelle-priser bag os. Samtidig har vi bevaret en kultur, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og hvor alle hjælper hinanden.

Hos os er der ikke langt fra tanke til beslutning. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar, sund fornuft og ordentlighed – både over for kunderne og hinanden.

 

DET MED SMÅT

Din daglige base bliver vores kontor i Silkeborg, men en del af arbejdstiden vil foregå på de ejendomme, vi passer. Du vil blandt andet være med til at starte nye ejendomme i Aalborg, når vi udvider vores aktiviteter.

Vi søger en medarbejder til opstart seneste d. 1/10, men gerne allerede i løbet af september.

Vi tilbyder en hverdag med stor fleksibilitet, gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid.

 

VIL DU MED?

Drop bare ansøgningen. Send os i stedet dit CV og et par linjer om, hvorfor du synes, jobbet lyder spændende.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Vi er et moderne skadecenter, hvor vi lever af kvalitetsarbejde og at yde god service. Trives du med at arbejde i en struktureret og planlagt dagligdag, hvor du ved, hvad morgendagen bringer af arbejdsopgaver? Ønsker du samtidigt at have mulighed for at præge din hverdag, hvor vi imødekommer individuelle ønsker og tilpasser dine opgaver ud fra dine kompetencer - så er du måske vores nye pladesmed/karroseritekniker på vores pladeværksted i Skovlunde!

 

Bliv en del af et moderne grønt smart repair skadecenter:

✔️ Vi servicerer og reparerer biler af højeste kvalitet, så derfor er din ekspertise og vores faciliteter selvfølgelig i samme klasse.

✔️ Vi har god gulvplads på værkstedet, du får egen lift og værktøj

✔️ Buledoktor har egen maler afdeling der maler alle skader hvor dette ikke kan undgås

 

Du får gode udviklingsmuligheder:

✔️ Du vil komme til at arbejde med kunder fra Danmarks største forsikringsselskaber. Det er vigtigt for os, at du er passioneret omkring dit arbejde, du får mulighed for at udvikle dig i dit arbejde gennem nye opgaver og løbende videreuddannelse i buledoktor organisation der har 35 lokationer i Danmark og flere er på vej

✔️ Vi vægter frihed under ansvar, og du vil opleve at du får tilstrækkelig tid til at løse opgaverne, da kvaliteten i arbejdet og 5-stjernet trust pilot vurdering er alfa og omega

 

Vi forventer:

✔️ Du er udlært pladesmed, og har stor erfaring med faget

✔️ Du har erfaring med kundehåndtering og det er naturligt for dig at kunden får den bedste kunderejse igennem hele skadesforløbet

✔️ Du har erfaring med taksering af autoskader via forsi

✔️ Du går op i at levere den højeste kvalitet hver gang

✔️ Du kan lide en varieret hverdag med stor fokus på opretning

✔️ Du har et godt humør og bidrager positivt til den gode ånd i vores virksomhed

 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mogens på tlf. 50191688 eller send din ansøgning på mail til: info@buledoktor.dk 

Der afholdes løbende samtaler.

 

Om Buledoktor: 

Buledoktor er hurtigere og bedre for miljøet med smart repair!

Buledoktor er førende grøn smart reparatør af autoskader i Danmark med eller uden lakering af alle biler. Vi laver alle typer parkerings-, små skader samt Bilka buler også kaldet ”smart repair”. Med smart repair forsøger vi at bevare og reparere alle bilens originale dele i stedet for at skifte delene.

Med vores teknikere til buleopretning kan vi hos Buledoktor udbedre skader hurtigere, billigere og på en mere miljøskånsom måde end traditionelle metoder.

Hvis der ikke er lakskade, kan vi rette alle buler, hvor materialet ikke har strakt sig. Ved at bruge de samme metoder som benyttes på bilfabrikkerne ved kontrol af nye biler, kan vores erfarne teknikere rette buler og genoprette bilens oprindelige form uden spartling og lakering.

Hvis vi kan undgå at lakere, undgår vi at spartle, lakere, eller udskifte dele, og så bruger vi absolut ingen kemikalier, hvilket naturligvis er godt for miljøet.

Skulle uheldet være ude og der er en skade på din bil kan vi også lakere bilen. Vores teknikere retter bulen op på den grønne måde hvor vi stadig sparer masser af CO2 udledning hvorefter vores autolakerer maler skaden. Vi samarbejder med Danmarks største autolakerer.

 

Vi kan ofte udbedre skaden på kundens bilen mens kunden venter med grøn smart repair. Derfor har vi venteområde på alle vores værksteder hvor du kan drikke en god kop kaffe eller arbejde på din computer mens du venter.

Buledoktor har 4,5 stjerner ud af 5 på Trustpilot.

jobs.title: Pædagog med hjerte for de mindste
jobs.description:
Vi søger en pædagog til vores Dagtilbud i en tidsbegrænset stilling på 25 timer ugentligt frem til 31. juli 2027.

Har du lyst til at være med, mens noget nyt tager form? Og brænder du for nærværende pædagogik, trygge relationer og gode overgange i børns liv?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger i Agernhaven.

En særlig opstarts- og udviklingsperiode

Agernhaven har udvidet vores dagtilbud med en vuggestue, og vi står derfor i en spændende opstarts- og udviklingsperiode.

I denne periode ønsker vi at styrke den pædagogiske indsats omkring vores nye vuggestue og samtidig skabe en stærk sammenhæng mellem vuggestue og børnehave. Derfor tilfører vi i opstartsperioden en ekstra pædagogisk ressource.

Du bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at etablere og udvikle vuggestuens pædagogiske hverdag og med at skabe den røde tråd gennem Agernhaven. Vi ønsker, at børn og forældre oplever Agernhaven som ét sammenhængende dagtilbud, hvor relationer, værdier og pædagogisk praksis følger barnet – også når barnet bevæger sig fra vuggestue til børnehave.

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset, fordi den knytter sig til denne særlige opstarts- og udviklingsperiode frem til sommeren 2027.

Om Agernhaven

Agernhaven er et lille dagtilbud med både vuggestue og børnehave. Hos os vægter vi det nære fællesskab højt, og vi ønsker at skabe en hverdag, hvor børnene mødes med tryghed, nærvær og genkendelighed.

Vi arbejder med en kombination af spontanitet og struktur og lægger vægt på faglig refleksion, sprog, tidlig indsats og stærke relationer.

Agernhaven bygger på kristne værdier, som er en naturlig del af vores menneskesyn, fællesskab og pædagogiske arbejde.

Din opgave bliver blandt andet at

  • være en aktiv del af den fortsatte etablering og udvikling af vores nye vuggestue

  • bidrage til at udvikle en tryg og nærværende pædagogisk hverdag for de yngste børn

  • være med til at skabe sammenhæng i pædagogik, værdier og praksis mellem vuggestue og børnehave

  • udvikle og styrke gode overgange for børn og forældre fra vuggestue til børnehave

  • bidrage med faglige perspektiver, idéer og refleksioner i vores lille medarbejdergruppe

  • være med til at udvikle Agernhaven som ét samlet dagtilbud.

Vi søger dig, der

  • er uddannet pædagog

  • har blik for det lille barns behov for tryghed, nærvær og stabile relationer

  • kan se værdien i at skabe sammenhæng på tværs af vuggestue og børnehave

  • har et solidt fagligt fundament og trives i reflekterende dialog med kolleger

  • tager ansvar og trives i et lille team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • kan identificere dig med de kristne værdier, som danner grundlag for vores pædagogik

  • møder børn, forældre og kolleger med åbenhed, engagement og gerne en god portion humor.

Vi tilbyder dig

Et lille og nært arbejdsfællesskab, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling, og hvor du får reel mulighed for at sætte dit faglige præg på en vuggestue, der fortsat er under udvikling.

Du får samtidig en særlig mulighed for at være med til at forme sammenhængen mellem vuggestue og børnehave og være med til at udvikle den måde, vi skaber gode overgange gennem Agernhaven.

Om stillingens varighed

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset til 31. juli 2027 og er etableret som en ekstra pædagogisk ressource knyttet til opstarts- og udviklingsperioden for Agernhavens vuggestue og arbejdet med at skabe sammenhæng mellem vuggestue og børnehave.

Når opstartsperioden nærmer sig sin afslutning, vil Agernhaven tage stilling til den fremtidige organisering og bemanding af det samlede dagtilbud. Der kan derfor opstå mulighed for efterfølgende ansættelse, men dette er ikke afklaret på nuværende tidspunkt og er ikke en del af den tidsbegrænsede ansættelse.

Ansættelse sker i henhold til vilkår aftalt mellem BUPL/FOA og Aftaleenheden ved frie grundskoler.

Interesseret?

Du kan læse mere om Agernhaven på vores hjemmeside: www.agernhaven.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller til vores nye vuggestue, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os.

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt og senest 1. november 2026
Ugentligt timetal: 25 timer
Ansættelsesperiode: Fra tiltrædelsesdato og frem til 31. juli 2027
Ansøgningsfrist: 23. september 2026

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Stillingen kan derfor blive besat inden ansøgningsfristens udløb.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Operatør til produktion i Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Har du produktionserfaring, er du praktisk anlagt og trives du i et team, hvor sikkerhed, samarbejde og godt humør går hånd i hånd?
Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos Alumichem søger vi en produktionsoperatør til vores team i Kalundborg, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med produktion af avancerede vandrensningsløsninger.
 

Du behøver ikke komme med en bestemt uddannelsesbaggrund.
Det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt, nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære. Vi sørger for den nødvendige oplæring og uddannelse i dine arbejdsopgaver.

 Måske har du erfaring fra produktion, måske har du en håndværksmæssig baggrund, eller måske bruger du din fritid på at skrue i maskiner, pumper eller andet teknisk udstyr. Uanset din baggrund er det vigtigste, at du kan lide at bruge hænderne og tager ansvar for dit arbejde.
 

En arbejdsplads med fokus på sikkerhed og fællesskab
Hos os er sikkerhed en topprioritet. Vi passer på hinanden og hjælper hinanden med at skabe en sikker og professionel arbejdsplads.

 Du bliver en del af et uformelt og engageret arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi lægger vægt på både faglighed, trivsel og godt samarbejde. Vi kommer med forskellige baggrunde og kompetencer, men fælles for os er, at vi tager vores arbejde seriøst – samtidig med at der er plads til humor og et godt grin.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som produktionsoperatør vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver blandt andet være:

  • Overvågning af maskiner under drift

  • Omstilling af maskiner ved skift til andre produkter

  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af produktionsudstyr

  • Udførelse af kontrolmålinger

  • Læsning og losning af lastbiler

  • Diverse praktiske og produktionsrelaterede opgaver

På sigt kan 1-2 weekendvagter om måneden komme på tale.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra produktion eller procesindustri

  • Eventuelt er uddannet industrioperatør eller procesoperatør

  • Har truckcertifikat

  • Har en håndværksmæssig eller teknisk baggrund

  • Er praktisk anlagt og ikke er bange for at tage fat

  • Arbejder struktureret og ansvarsbevidst

  • Trives med at arbejde både selvstændigt og som en del af et team

Det er en fordel, hvis du også har

  • ADR-bevis

  • Teknisk interesse og flair for maskiner og udstyr

  • En god portion humoristisk sans
     

Din personlighed og tilgang til arbejdet er mindst lige så vigtig som din baggrund
Har du den rette indstilling og lyst til at lære, sørger vi for, at du bliver godt klædt på til jobbet.

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt til:
career@alumichem.com
